name: Avocado Eggs on Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Boil or scramble the eggs to your liking.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread avocado on toast, top with egg and chilli flakes.
Serve right away.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into two bowls.
Wash the berries and pat them dry.
Top yogurt with berries and granola.
Drizzle honey and scatter chia seeds.
Eat fresh.

name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Cook spinach in olive oil for 2 minutes until soft.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently.
Add chopped tomato and crumbled feta.
Fold, rest 1 minute, then serve.

name: Warm Oats with Banana and Peanut Butter
steps: Put oats and milk in a pot on medium heat.
Stir for 5 to 7 minutes until thick.
Spoon into bowls.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.
Serve warm.

name: Fluffy Pancakes with Berries
steps: Mix flour and baking powder in a big bowl.
Whisk milk and eggs in a second bowl, then combine. Rest 5 minutes.
Cook small ladles of batter for 2 minutes each side.
Stack and top with berries and maple syrup.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Cook onion and capsicum in a pan for 5 minutes.
Add cumin and crushed tomato. Simmer 8 minutes.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 6 minutes until whites are set.
Serve with warm bread.

name: Green Smoothie and Toast Soldiers
steps: Put banana, spinach, yogurt and milk in a blender.
Blend 60 seconds until smooth.
Toast the bread and cut into strips.
Pour and serve right away.

name: Grilled Chicken Wraps
steps: Season chicken and grill 6 to 7 minutes each side.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, chicken and mayonnaise.
Roll, cut in half and serve.

name: Greek Salad with Grilled Halloumi
steps: Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion into chunks.
Add olives, olive oil and lemon juice. Toss well.
Fry halloumi slices 2 minutes each side until golden.
Lay halloumi over the salad and serve.

name: Tuna Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and let it rest 5 minutes.
Warm the corn.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise.
Bowl up rice, tuna, corn and chopped cucumber.
Drizzle soy sauce and serve.

name: Bean and Cheese Quesadillas
steps: Mash half the beans with a fork.
Spread beans on tortillas, add cheese and corn.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 3 minutes each side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Falafel Pitas with Tzatziki
steps: Bake falafel as the pack says, about 15 minutes.
Grate cucumber, squeeze dry, mix with yogurt.
Warm the pitas.
Fill pitas with lettuce, tomato, falafel and tzatziki.

name: Italian Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta, drain and cool under cold water.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and tear the mozzarella.
Mix pasta with tomato, mozzarella, salami and basil.
Dress with olive oil, rest 10 minutes, serve.

name: Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice ahead and chill it if you can. Cold rice fries best.
Scramble eggs in a hot pan, set aside.
Fry diced carrot and peas for 4 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce, toss 3 minutes.
Fold in egg and spring onion. Serve hot.

name: Beef Tacos with Slaw
steps: Brown the mince in a hot pan, breaking it up.
Add taco seasoning and a splash of water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Shred cabbage and mix with lime juice.
Warm the shells.
Fill shells with mince, slaw, cheese and sour cream.

name: Lemon Chicken Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cut potato into chunks and zucchini into thick slices.
Toss everything on a tray with oil, oregano and lemon.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

name: Salmon with Greens and Rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Steam broccoli for 5 minutes.
Pan fry salmon skin side down for 6 minutes, then 2 minutes more.
Add garlic, soy sauce and lemon to the pan.
Serve salmon over rice with greens.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Cook onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add mince and brown it well.
Add crushed tomato and simmer 25 minutes.
Cook spaghetti in salty water.
Serve sauce over spaghetti with parmesan.

name: Chicken Coconut Curry
steps: Fry curry paste for 1 minute until it smells great.
Add chicken pieces and coat them well.
Add coconut milk and sweet potato chunks. Simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach until soft.
Serve over rice.

name: Beef and Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Sear beef in a very hot pan for 3 minutes. Set aside.
Stir fry capsicum, broccoli and ginger for 4 minutes.
Return beef, add soy sauce, toss 1 minute.
Serve over rice.

name: Lamb Kofta with Couscous
steps: Mix lamb with cumin, parsley and salt. Shape into logs.
Grill or fry 10 to 12 minutes, turning often.
Pour hot water over couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff.
Mix yogurt with grated cucumber.
Serve kofta on couscous with the yogurt.

name: Bean Chilli with Rice
steps: Cook onion for 5 minutes.
Add paprika, beans, tomato and corn.
Simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Cook the rice.
Serve chilli over rice.

name: Oven Fish and Sweet Potato Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cut sweet potato into chips, bake 25 minutes.
Dip fish in beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Bake fish 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with peas and lemon wedges.

name: Easy Butter Chicken
steps: Melt butter and fry garam masala for 30 seconds.
Add chicken and brown for 6 minutes.
Add passata and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Serve over rice.

name: Minestrone Soup with Crusty Bread
steps: Put stock, tomato, carrot and zucchini in a big pot.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans and small pasta. Cook 10 minutes more.
Rest 5 minutes.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Chicken Satay Noodles
steps: Cook noodles as the pack says.
Fry chicken strips for 7 minutes.
Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and warm water into a sauce.
Toss noodles, chicken, capsicum and sauce together.
Serve hot.

name: Bacon and Eggs on Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Fry the bacon in a pan until crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the eggs to your liking.
Put bacon and eggs on the toast.
Serve right away.

name: Veggie Breakfast Hash
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, capsicum and potato and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Berry Oat Smoothie
steps: Put mixed berries, banana, greek yogurt and milk in a blender.
Add rolled oats and honey.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Baked Eggs with Tomato and Basil
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Pour the crushed tomato into a small oven dish with the olive oil.
Crack the eggs into the dish.
Bake for 12 minutes until the eggs are just set.
Top with feta and basil and serve with the bread.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread peanut butter thickly on each slice.
Slice the banana and lay it on top.
Dust with cinnamon and drizzle with honey.
Serve right away.

name: Mushroom Spinach Scramble
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook mushroom and spinach for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with butter and cheese and serve.

name: Ham and Cheese Toastie
steps: Butter the bread on the outside of each slice.
Fill with ham and cheese.
Cook in a sandwich press or a hot pan for 4 minutes until the cheese melts.
Rest 1 minute, then cut in half.
Serve hot.

name: Cinnamon Oats with Berries
steps: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cinnamon, honey and chia seeds.
Top with mixed berries and serve warm.

name: Bacon Breakfast Burrito
steps: Cook bacon until done.
Cook the egg to your liking.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with cheese.
Add salsa and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Greek Eggs with Feta and Tomato
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook tomato and olives for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with feta and oregano and serve.

name: Sweet Potato and Bacon Hash
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add bacon, egg and sweet potato and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Serve hot.

name: Yogurt Granola Cups
steps: Spoon half the greek yogurt into two glasses.
Add a layer of granola and sliced banana.
Repeat with the rest of the yogurt and granola.
Drizzle honey over the top.
Serve right away.

name: Corn and Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the extra water.
Mix zucchini, corn, egg, flour and chopped spring onion into a batter.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry spoonfuls of batter for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve hot.

name: Ricotta Honey Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the ricotta thickly on each slice.
Drizzle with honey.
Add a squeeze of lemon over the top.
Serve right away.

name: Breakfast Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, ham and frozen peas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Potato and Cheese Breakfast Skillet
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and potato and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with cheese and butter and serve hot.

name: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add tofu, spinach and tomato and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Ricotta Pancakes with Honey
steps: Whisk flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Stir in ricotta, egg and milk into a thick batter.
Melt the butter in a big pan.
Fry small pancakes for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Serve warm with honey.

name: Banana Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia seeds, milk, greek yogurt, peanut butter and cinnamon in a bowl.
Rest in the fridge for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Stir well so there are no lumps.
Top with sliced banana.
Serve cold.

name: Herb and Cheese Baked Eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put the spinach in a small oven dish and pour the cream over.
Crack the eggs over the top.
Scatter cheese and parsley over.
Bake for 12 minutes until the eggs are just set.

name: Salmon and Egg Toast
steps: Cook salmon until done.
Cook the egg to your liking.
Toast the bread until golden.
Fill with ricotta.
Add lemon and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Bean and Egg Breakfast Burrito
steps: Cook the egg to your liking.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with black beans, capsicum, cheese and sour cream.
Serve right away.

name: Berry Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Stir rolled oats, greek yogurt, milk, chia seeds and honey in a bowl.
Cover and rest in the fridge overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Stir well so the chia seeds are spread through.
Top with mixed berries.
Serve cold.

name: Banana and Oat Smoothie
steps: Put banana, greek yogurt and milk in a blender.
Add rolled oats, honey and cinnamon.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Cook chicken breast until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with lettuce and parmesan.
Add mayonnaise and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Drain the tuna and tip it into a bowl.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise, chopped celery and a squeeze of lemon.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill the bread with lettuce and the tuna mix.
Serve right away.

name: Greek Chicken Pita
steps: Cook chicken breast until done.
Warm the pita bread.
Fill with cucumber, tomato, feta and greek yogurt.
Add oregano and lemon and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Chickpea and Cucumber Salad
steps: Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion.
Put chickpeas and feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, lemon and parsley and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Tomato Mozzarella Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread pesto on each slice.
Layer mozzarella and tomato slices.
Top with basil leaves.
Serve right away.

name: Red Lentil and Carrot Soup
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, carrot and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, add a squeeze of lemon and serve hot.

name: Ham and Cheese Wrap
steps: Warm the tortilla.
Fill with ham, lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Add mayonnaise and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Salmon Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook salmon until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop cucumber, spring onion and avocado.
Add soy sauce and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Falafel Salad Bowl
steps: Chop lettuce, tomato, cucumber and red onion.
Put falafel and greek yogurt in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool and peel.
Mash the eggs with mayonnaise and chopped spring onion.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill the bread with lettuce and the egg mix.
Serve right away.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cherry tomato, cucumber, olives and red onion.
Put tuna in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Mexican Bean Salad
steps: Chop corn, capsicum, red onion and avocado.
Put black beans in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, cumin and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Halloumi and Beetroot Salad
steps: Chop beetroot and spinach.
Put halloumi in a big bowl.
Add pine nuts, honey, olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chicken Avocado Sandwich
steps: Cook the chicken breast until done and slice it.
Toast the bread until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Fill with chicken, avocado, lettuce and tomato.
Serve right away.

name: Prawn and Avocado Salad
steps: Cook prawns until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop lettuce, cucumber and avocado.
Add olive oil, chilli flakes and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Roast Veg Couscous Bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop zucchini, capsicum and red onion and roast with chickpeas and olive oil for 20 minutes.
Pour hot water over the couscous and rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Mix the roast veg through the couscous.
Top with feta and a squeeze of lemon and serve.

name: Bacon Lettuce Tomato Sandwich
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Fill with bacon, lettuce and tomato slices.
Serve right away.

name: Tuna and Bean Salad
steps: Chop lettuce and red onion.
Put tuna and black beans in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, parsley and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Spicy Tuna Wrap
steps: Warm the tortilla.
Fill with tuna, cucumber and lettuce.
Add mayonnaise and chilli flakes and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Chicken Greek Salad
steps: Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop tomato, cucumber, olives and red onion.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, oregano and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Pumpkin and Feta Salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop the pumpkin into cubes and roast with olive oil for 20 minutes.
Put spinach in a big bowl.
Top with warm pumpkin, feta and pine nuts.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Chilli Noodle Salad
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop capsicum, carrot and spring onion.
Add soy sauce, chilli flakes, peanut butter and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Salami and Cheese Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread lightly.
Spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Fill with salami, cheese, tomato and lettuce.
Press gently and cut in half.
Serve right away.

name: Curried Egg Wrap
steps: Cook the egg to your liking.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with spinach.
Add mayonnaise and garam masala and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Tomato Bruschetta
steps: Toast the bread until crisp and golden.
Rub the toast with the cut garlic clove.
Chop the tomato and mix with basil and olive oil.
Spoon the tomato mix onto the toast.
Top with torn mozzarella and serve.

name: Chicken Korma
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and broccoli and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Garlic Prawn Pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss everything together.
Top with parsley and lemon and serve hot.

name: Lamb Kofta Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop red onion, garlic and potato into chunks.
Add lamb mince, cumin and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with greek yogurt and lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry chicken breast strips with taco seasoning for 8 minutes.
Add sliced capsicum and onion and cook 5 more minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill tortillas with the chicken mix, sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

name: Vegetable Lasagne
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put garlic, zucchini, capsicum, mushroom, spinach and pasta in a big oven dish.
Pour over crushed tomato and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 47 minutes.
Top with ricotta and mozzarella and serve hot.

name: Salmon and Potato Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, green beans and potato into chunks.
Add salmon to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Chicken Tikka Skewers
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix greek yogurt, garam masala, garlic and ginger and coat the chicken thigh pieces.
Rest the chicken for 10 minutes to soak up the flavours.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 12 minutes until charred at the edges.
Serve over rice with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, broccoli, capsicum and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Chicken Parmigiana
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Bake the chicken on a tray with potato wedges and olive oil for 20 minutes.
Spoon tomato passata over the chicken and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 10 more minutes until the mozzarella melts and bubbles.

name: White Fish Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Pork and Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Greek Chicken and Potato Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop red onion, garlic and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 37 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Beef Chilli con Carne
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, kidney beans, smoked paprika and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Hearty Chicken Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken thigh, carrot, celery, corn and onion and cook for 20 minutes.
Take the chicken out, shred it and put it back.
Add the noodles and cook 8 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Creamy Salmon Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and frozen peas and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and lemon and serve hot.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add mushroom and spinach and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and serve hot.

name: Chicken Schnitzel with Mash
steps: Boil the potato until soft, then mash with milk and butter.
Dip the chicken breast in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 5 minutes each side until golden.
Steam the green beans for 5 minutes.
Serve the schnitzel with mash, beans and a wedge of lemon.

name: Prawn Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg and frozen peas and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Mix pasta with tuna, corn and cream in a big oven dish.
Scatter cheese on top.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Lamb, Feta and Potato Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop red onion, cherry tomato and potato into chunks.
Add lamb mince and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Satay Chicken with Rice
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum, peanut butter and soy sauce and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Beef Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Fry beef mince, onion and garlic in olive oil until browned.
Mix pasta, beef and crushed tomato in a big oven dish and top with mozzarella and basil.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Pork Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, egg, cabbage and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum, olives and oregano and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, carrot and oregano and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the spaghetti.

name: Prawn Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add prawns, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Beef Nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Fry the beef mince until browned and stir in the black beans.
Cut the tortillas into triangles and bake for 6 minutes until crisp.
Put the tortilla chips on a tray and top with beef mix, capsicum and cheese.
Bake 8 more minutes, then top with salsa and sour cream.

name: Salmon and Coconut Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Add salmon, green beans and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Halloumi Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop red onion, zucchini, capsicum, cherry tomato and potato into chunks.
Add oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with halloumi and lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Hotpot
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, potato, carrot and frozen peas and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir the flour into the cream, then stir it through the hotpot and cook 3 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Beef Noodle Stir Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, capsicum and cabbage and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Mexican Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add chicken breast, kidney beans, corn and capsicum and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in taco seasoning and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with cheese and lime and serve over the rice.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with ricotta, parmesan and lemon and serve hot.

name: Honey Soy Pork
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and green beans and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Baked Fish with Wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cut the potato into wedges and bake with olive oil for 20 minutes.
Dip the white fish in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Add the fish to the tray and bake 12 more minutes.
Serve with peas and a wedge of lemon.

name: Zucchini Slice
steps: Heat the oven to 170 degrees.
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the extra water.
Whisk the eggs and flour in a big bowl.
Stir in zucchini, bacon, cheese, onion and olive oil.
Pour into a lined dish and bake for 30 minutes until set and golden.

name: Tofu Satay Skewers
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add tofu and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter, soy sauce and coconut milk and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Greek Beef Meatballs
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano and garlic and roll into balls.
Fry the meatballs in olive oil until browned all over.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 12 minutes.
Serve over rice and top with crumbled feta.

name: Pesto Chicken Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop cherry tomato, green beans and potato into chunks.
Add chicken breast and pesto to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with mozzarella and serve hot.

name: Breakfast Tacos
steps: Cook bacon until done.
Cook the egg to your liking.
Warm the taco shells.
Fill with cheese.
Add salsa and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Greek Yogurt and Honey Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread greek yogurt thickly on each slice.
Top with sliced banana.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Serve right away.

name: Masala Eggs
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, spring onion and tomato for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with butter and garam masala and serve.

name: Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Scramble the eggs in a pan until just set.
Lay egg, ham, cheese and capsicum over one half of each tortilla.
Fold the tortillas in half.
Cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
Serve hot.

name: Spinach and Feta Egg Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Whisk the eggs and milk in a jug.
Stir in spinach, chopped tomato and crumbled feta.
Pour into a greased muffin tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until set and golden.

name: Carrot Cake Oats
steps: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 11 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cinnamon, honey, sugar and carrot.
Top with greek yogurt and serve warm.

name: Eggs with Spicy Beans
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes, then add black beans, crushed tomato and chilli flakes.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make little wells and crack the eggs in.
Cover and cook 5 minutes, then serve on toasted bread.

name: Berry and Banana Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend most of the mixed berries with banana, milk, peanut butter, rolled oats and honey until thick and smooth.
Spoon into two bowls.
Top with the rest of the mixed berries.
Serve cold right away.

name: Tofu and Spinach Wrap
steps: Cook tofu until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with spinach and tomato.
Add mayonnaise and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Greek Village Omelette
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Fry thin potato slices for 6 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs and pour them over the potato.
Add tomato and olives and cook gently until just set.
Top with feta and oregano and serve.

name: Feta and Tomato Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Crumble feta over each slice.
Top with tomato slices and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and scatter oregano.
Serve right away.

name: French Toast with Berries
steps: Whisk egg, milk and cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
Dip the bread slices in the mix until soaked.
Melt the butter in a big pan and fry the bread for 2 minutes each side.
Top with mixed berries.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

name: Spiced Potato and Egg Fry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and potato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Salmon Scramble on Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Melt the butter in a pan and scramble the eggs gently.
Flake in the salmon and warm through for 1 minute.
Pile the eggs onto the toast.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chilaquiles Eggs
steps: Cut the tortillas into triangles and fry in a dry hot pan until crisp.
Pour the salsa into the pan and warm through.
Scramble the eggs in a second pan.
Mix the eggs through the salsa and tortilla crisps with the onion.
Top with cheese and sour cream and serve.

name: Green Breakfast Smoothie
steps: Put banana, avocado and milk in a blender.
Add honey, chia seeds and spinach.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Denver Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, capsicum and ham for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and butter and serve.

name: Cauliflower Breakfast Hash
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and cauliflower and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Baked Beans and Eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix kidney beans, crushed tomato, oregano and olive oil in an oven dish.
Make little wells and crack the eggs in.
Bake for 15 minutes until the eggs are just set.
Top with feta and serve with the bread.

name: Sweet Rice Porridge
steps: Put rice and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 16 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cinnamon and sugar.
Top with banana and serve warm.

name: Zucchini and Herb Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put zucchini and egg in a big oven dish.
Pour over milk and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 12 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley and serve hot.

name: Greek Meze Plate
steps: Warm the pita bread and the falafel as the pack says.
Chop cucumber and tomato into chunks.
Put falafel, feta, olives, cucumber and tomato on two plates.
Add a big spoon of greek yogurt to each plate.
Serve with the pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken Tikka Wrap
steps: Mix half the greek yogurt with the garam masala and coat the chicken breast.
Fry the chicken until cooked through, then slice it.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with chicken, lettuce, tomato and cucumber.
Add the rest of the greek yogurt, roll up and serve.

name: Smoky Chicken Sandwich
steps: Cook the chicken breast until done and slice it.
Mix the mayonnaise with the smoked paprika.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill with chicken, cheese, lettuce and tomato.
Serve right away.

name: Warm Lentil Salad
steps: Cook lentils until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop spinach and red onion.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, parsley and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chicken Taco Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop corn and lettuce.
Put black beans in a big bowl.
Add salsa and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Corn Chowder
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add bacon, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cream and butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot, topped with parsley.

name: Prawn Tacos
steps: Cook prawns until done.
Warm the taco shells.
Fill with cabbage.
Add mayonnaise, chilli flakes and lime and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Chop tomato.
Put mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and basil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Greek Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cucumber, cherry tomato, olives and red onion.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, oregano and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Tuna Melt
steps: Drain the tuna and mix it with mayonnaise and chopped spring onion.
Toast the bread lightly.
Top the bread with tuna mix and tomato slices.
Scatter cheese over the top.
Grill or bake for 4 minutes until the cheese melts.

name: Chicken Noodle Salad
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop capsicum, carrot and spring onion.
Add soy sauce and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chickpea Smash Sandwich
steps: Drain the chickpeas and smash them roughly with a fork.
Mix chickpeas with avocado, a squeeze of lemon and chilli flakes.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill with lettuce and the chickpea smash.
Serve right away.

name: Spiced Lentil and Tomato Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato, vegetable stock and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Bacon Lettuce Tomato Wrap
steps: Cook bacon until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with lettuce and tomato.
Add mayonnaise and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Tzatziki Pita with Salad
steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the extra water.
Mix cucumber with greek yogurt, crushed garlic, a squeeze of lemon and olive oil.
Warm the pita bread.
Chop tomato and lettuce into a small salad.
Serve the pita bread with the yogurt mix and salad.

name: Tuna Poke Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cucumber, spring onion and avocado.
Put tuna in a big bowl.
Add soy sauce, chilli flakes and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chicken Couscous Salad
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop cucumber and cherry tomato.
Add olive oil, parsley and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Turkish Style Eggs
steps: Mix greek yogurt with crushed garlic and spread it on two plates.
Melt the butter with the chilli flakes until it foams.
Poach or fry the eggs to your liking.
Put the eggs on the yogurt and pour the hot butter over.
Serve with the bread.

name: Beef Taco Salad
steps: Cook beef mince until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop lettuce, tomato and corn.
Put black beans and cheese in a big bowl.
Add salsa and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Ham and Potato Salad
steps: Boil the potato until just soft, then cool a little.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix potato, ham, egg and spring onion in a big bowl.
Add mayonnaise and parsley and toss well.
Serve warm or cold.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop cherry tomato and spinach.
Put parmesan in a big bowl.
Add pesto and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Cauliflower Fritters
steps: Chop the cauliflower small and steam or boil for 5 minutes until soft.
Mix cauliflower with egg, flour, garam masala and chopped spring onion.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry spoonfuls of the mix for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Mexican Corn Salad
steps: Chop corn, capsicum and red onion.
Put black beans and feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Salami Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cherry tomato, cucumber and olives.
Put salami and mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and basil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chicken Avocado Wrap
steps: Cook chicken breast until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, avocado and sour cream.
Serve right away.

name: Moussaka
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince, onion and garlic in olive oil until browned, then stir in crushed tomato and cinnamon.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Layer potato slices and beef mix in an oven dish, pour the sauce over and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and garam masala and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in rice, greek yogurt and frozen peas with 500 ml water.
Cover and cook on low for 20 minutes until the rice is soft.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff and serve hot.

name: Chicken Tacos
steps: Fry the chicken breast with taco seasoning until cooked through, then slice it.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Fill the shells with chicken, lettuce and tomato.
Top with cheese and sour cream.
Serve right away.

name: Lamb Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 40 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Greek Pork Skewers
steps: Mix pork mince with oregano and garlic and shape onto skewers or into long patties.
Fry in olive oil for 12 minutes, turning until cooked through.
Warm the pita bread.
Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion into a salad.
Serve the skewers in pita bread with salad, greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Smoky Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, egg and smoked paprika and roll into balls.
Fry the meatballs in olive oil until browned all over.
Pour in tomato passata and honey and simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with butter and milk.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the mash.

name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan, butter and parsley and serve hot.

name: Beef Kofta Curry
steps: Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, egg and half the garam masala and roll into balls.
Fry the kofta in olive oil until browned all over.
Add onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomato and coconut milk with the rest of the garam masala and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.

name: Fish Tacos
steps: Fry the white fish until golden and flaky.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Mix mayonnaise with chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Fill the shells with fish, cabbage and corn.
Drizzle the sauce over and serve.

name: Greek Baked Salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put cherry tomato, olives, salmon and potato in a big oven dish.
Pour over oregano and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 17 minutes.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Shawarma Plate
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Coat chicken thigh with cumin, smoked paprika and olive oil.
Fry the chicken for 12 minutes until charred at the edges, then slice it.
Chop cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve chicken over rice with salad, greek yogurt, pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef and Mushroom Stew
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, mushroom, carrot and potato and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 45 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the flour, topped with parsley.

name: Prawn and Salami Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big wide pan or pot.
Fry salami and capsicum for 3 minutes.
Add rice, crushed tomato, smoked paprika and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Lay prawns and frozen peas on top, cover and cook 6 more minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Peanut Chicken Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum, peanut butter and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Lamb Tacos
steps: Fry the lamb mince with taco seasoning until browned and crisp at the edges.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Fill the shells with lamb, lettuce and tomato.
Top with feta and greek yogurt.
Serve right away.

name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, carrot and garam masala and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in rice, frozen peas and 500 ml water.
Cover and cook on low for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with greek yogurt.

name: Chicken and Salami Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop red onion, capsicum, cherry tomato and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh, salami and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve hot.

name: Beef Noodle Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add beef strips, carrot, ginger, garlic and soy sauce and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in spinach until it wilts.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Salmon Fish Cakes
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash it roughly.
Flake the salmon and mix with potato, egg, breadcrumbs and chopped spring onion.
Shape into 8 cakes.
Fry in olive oil for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with lettuce, mayonnaise and a wedge of lemon.

name: Pork Meatball Noodle Soup
steps: Mix pork mince with the egg, ginger and garlic and roll into small balls.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Drop the meatballs in and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the noodles and spinach and cook 4 more minutes.
Add soy sauce, top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry the chicken breast with onion and taco seasoning, then shred it.
Fill the tortillas with chicken and black beans and roll them up in an oven dish.
Pour crushed tomato over and scatter cheese on top.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with sour cream.

name: Garlic Butter Prawns
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter, parsley and lemon and serve over the rice.

name: Beef and Potato Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, potato, curry paste and peanut butter and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Chicken and Ham Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put chicken breast, ham and broccoli in a big oven dish.
Pour the cream over and scatter garlic through.
Top with cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Bean and Corn Tacos
steps: Warm the black beans in a pot with cumin and mash a few with a fork.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Fill the shells with beans, corn and capsicum.
Top with avocado, salsa and cheese.
Serve with a squeeze of lime.

name: Honey Soy Salmon
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and broccoli and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Lamb and Lentil Stew
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook celery, onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, lentils, carrot and oregano and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Chicken Gyros
steps: Coat chicken thigh with oregano and olive oil.
Fry the chicken for 12 minutes until cooked through, then slice it.
Warm the pita bread.
Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion.
Fill pita bread with chicken and salad, add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Melt the butter in a big pan and fry onion, garlic and mushroom for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips and smoked paprika and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and warm through gently, do not boil.
Serve over the pasta and top with parsley.

name: Prawn and Tomato Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with basil and serve hot.

name: Herb Crumb Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Mix breadcrumbs with parmesan, parsley and garlic.
Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg, then in the crumb mix.
Bake the chicken with potato wedges, green beans and olive oil for 22 minutes.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Falafel Plate with Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the falafel as the pack says.
Chop cucumber, tomato and lettuce into a salad.
Warm the pita bread.
Serve falafel over rice with salad, greek yogurt, pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef Kebab Plate
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix beef mince with cumin, smoked paprika and garlic and shape into thick patties.
Fry in olive oil for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Chop cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve the kebabs over rice with salad, greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Sticky Chicken Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, broccoli and sweet potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh, honey and soy sauce to the tray.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve hot.

name: Vegetable Paella
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big wide pan.
Fry capsicum, zucchini and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add rice, crushed tomato, smoked paprika and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes.
Scatter frozen peas on top, cover and rest 5 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Creamy Tuna Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add tuna, frozen peas and corn and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with cheese and lemon and serve over the rice.

name: Pork and Cabbage Stir Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, cabbage and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Creamy Chicken and Mushroom Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and mushroom and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve over the rice.

name: Sweet Soy Beef Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry beef mince with garlic and ginger until browned.
Add honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes until glossy.
Serve beef over rice with carrot and cucumber on top.
Scatter spring onion over and serve.

name: Greek Chicken Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Fry chicken thigh and garlic in olive oil until golden.
Mix pasta, chicken, crushed tomato and olives in an oven dish.
Top with feta and oregano and bake for 20 minutes.

name: Lentil Cottage Pie
steps: Cook the lentils in vegetable stock for 20 minutes until soft.
Fry onion and carrot, then stir in lentils, crushed tomato and frozen peas.
Boil the potato and mash with milk and butter.
Put the lentil mix in an oven dish, top with mash and cheese.
Bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, capsicum, cabbage and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Crumbed Fish and Salad
steps: Dip the white fish in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in olive oil for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Chop lettuce, tomato and cucumber into a salad.
Serve the fish with salad and mayonnaise.
Add a wedge of lemon.

name: Mexican Lasagne
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince and onion with taco seasoning until browned.
Stir in black beans, corn and half the crushed tomato.
Layer tortillas and beef mix in an oven dish, like a lasagne.
Pour the rest of the crushed tomato over, top with cheese and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve with sour cream.

name: Italian Herb Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put cherry tomato and egg in a big oven dish.
Pour over milk and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 12 minutes.
Top with mozzarella and basil and serve hot.

name: Masala Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and frozen peas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Wilt the spinach in a hot pan with the garlic for 2 minutes.
Spread ricotta thickly on each slice.
Top with spinach, a squeeze of lemon and chilli flakes.
Serve right away.

name: Banana Bircher Oats
steps: Stir rolled oats, greek yogurt and milk in a bowl.
Cover and rest in the fridge overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Stir well.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and honey.
Serve cold.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, ginger, spring onion and tomato for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with butter, chilli flakes and cumin and serve.

name: Halloumi and Egg Plate
steps: Fry the halloumi in olive oil for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Chop tomato and cucumber into a salad with the olives.
Serve halloumi and eggs with the salad and bread.

name: Cinnamon French Toast
steps: Whisk egg, milk, cinnamon and sugar in a shallow bowl.
Dip the bread slices in the mix until soaked.
Melt the butter in a big pan and fry the bread for 2 minutes each side.
Cut into sticks if you like.
Serve warm with banana and maple syrup.

name: Tofu Breakfast Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, egg and spinach and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Greek Milk Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 170 degrees.
Whisk milk, egg, sugar and flour into a smooth batter.
Pour into an oven dish greased with the butter.
Bake for 30 minutes until set with golden spots.
Dust with cinnamon and add a squeeze of lemon.

name: Mexican Scrambled Eggs
steps: Melt the butter in a pan.
Fry onion, capsicum and tomato for 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and pour them in with the chilli flakes.
Stir gently until just set.
Serve in warm tortillas.

name: Oat Pancakes
steps: Blitz rolled oats into a rough flour.
Whisk oat flour, flour, baking powder, egg, milk and mashed banana into a batter.
Melt the butter in a big pan.
Fry small pancakes for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Serve warm with honey.

name: Hash Browns with Eggs
steps: Grate the potato and onion and squeeze out the extra water.
Mix with flour and shape into flat cakes.
Fry in butter for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Serve the hash browns with eggs and spring onion on top.

name: Garden Veggie Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook spring onion, zucchini, capsicum and mushroom for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and butter and serve.

name: Warm Chia Oats
steps: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in chia seeds, cinnamon and honey.
Top with banana and serve warm.

name: Spiced Chickpeas with Egg
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add chickpeas, crushed tomato and garam masala and simmer for 8 minutes.
Fry the eggs in a second pan.
Serve the chickpeas on toasted bread with an egg on top.

name: Breakfast Salad Bowl
steps: Cook egg and bacon until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop spinach, cherry tomato and avocado.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Coconut Rice Pudding
steps: Put rice and coconut milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 21 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in honey and cinnamon.
Top with mixed berries and serve warm.

name: Cheese and Tomato Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook tomato for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese, butter and parsley and serve.

name: Baked Berry Oats
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix rolled oats, milk, egg, honey, baking powder and cinnamon in an oven dish.
Fold in the mixed berries.
Bake for 22 minutes until set and golden on top.
Serve warm.

name: Spanish Style Eggs
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry onion, capsicum and zucchini for 6 minutes.
Add chopped tomato and smoked paprika and cook 4 more minutes.
Make little wells and crack the eggs in.
Cover and cook 5 minutes, then serve with toasted bread.

name: Pasta Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put frozen peas, egg, ham and pasta in a big oven dish.
Pour over milk.
Cover and bake for 17 minutes.
Top with cheese and serve hot.

name: Spiced Lentil Wraps
steps: Cook lentils until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with spinach, cucumber and greek yogurt.
Add garam masala and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Tuna and Corn Fritters
steps: Mix tuna, corn, egg, flour and chopped spring onion into a batter.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry spoonfuls of batter for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Caprese Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add cherry tomato and cook for 6 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with mozzarella and basil and serve hot.

name: Crumbed Chicken Sandwich
steps: Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden and cooked through, then slice.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill with chicken, lettuce and tomato.
Add mayonnaise and serve.

name: Beetroot and Feta Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beetroot and cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with feta, parsley and lemon and serve hot.

name: Indian Chickpea Salad
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber and red onion.
Put chickpeas in a big bowl.
Add cumin, chilli flakes, olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Salmon and Cucumber Sandwich
steps: Cook the salmon until just done and flake it.
Spread ricotta on the bread.
Fill with salmon, cucumber and spring onion.
Add a squeeze of lemon.
Serve right away.

name: Chicken and Corn Quesadillas
steps: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it thinly.
Lay chicken and corn over one half of each tortilla.
Top with cheese.
Fold and cook in a dry hot pan for 3 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

name: Lemon Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cucumber and olives.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, lemon and parsley and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Falafel Couscous Salad
steps: Warm the falafel as the pack says.
Pour hot water over the couscous and rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Chop tomato, cucumber and parsley.
Toss couscous with the salad, olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Top with falafel and serve.

name: Herb Chicken Wrap
steps: Cook chicken breast until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Add mayonnaise and parsley and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Tuna Mornay
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Mix pasta, tuna, corn and sauce in an oven dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and the rest of the cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

name: Pork and Slaw Sandwich
steps: Shape the pork mince into two patties with the smoked paprika.
Fry the patties until cooked through.
Mix cabbage with mayonnaise into a slaw.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill with patties, cheese and slaw and serve.

name: Simple Dal with Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp and boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Cook the chicken breast until done and slice it.
Toast the bread and cut it into croutons.
Put lettuce in a big bowl with chicken, bacon, egg and croutons.
Add mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon and parmesan and toss well.

name: Beetroot and Bean Burger
steps: Mash the black beans roughly with a fork.
Mix beans with grated beetroot, breadcrumbs and egg and shape into patties.
Fry in olive oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp.
Toast the bread.
Fill with patties, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise and serve.

name: Spanish Potato Omelette
steps: Fry thin potato slices and onion in olive oil for 12 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs and pour them over the potato.
Cook gently for 6 minutes until nearly set.
Flip carefully or finish under a hot grill for 2 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve warm.

name: Greek Tuna Salad
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, olives and red onion.
Put tuna and feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Mushroom and Pea Rice
steps: Melt the butter in a big pot and fry onion, garlic and mushroom for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is soft, about 18 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and parmesan.
Rest 2 minutes and serve.

name: Prawn Cocktail Salad
steps: Cook the prawns until pink, then cool a little.
Mix mayonnaise with a squeeze of lemon and chilli flakes.
Put lettuce and chopped tomato in two glasses or bowls.
Top with prawns and the sauce.
Serve with the bread.

name: Beef Lasagne
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince, onion and garlic in olive oil until browned, then stir in crushed tomato and simmer 10 minutes.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Layer pasta sheets and beef mix in an oven dish, pour the sauce over.
Top with the rest of the cheese and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Japanese Style Chicken Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, carrot, frozen peas, potato and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Spicy Pork Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, garam masala and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Lamb Shawarma Plate
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry lamb mince with cumin and smoked paprika in olive oil until crisp at the edges.
Chop tomato and red onion into a salad.
Warm the pita bread.
Serve lamb over rice with salad, greek yogurt, pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Country Beef Pie
steps: Fry beef mince, onion and carrot until browned, then stir in frozen peas and vegetable stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the beef mix and cover with pastry.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Fish Pie
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash with half the milk and half the butter.
Whisk flour into the rest of the milk, heat until thick.
Flake white fish and salmon through the sauce with frozen peas and parsley.
Put in an oven dish and top with mash and cheese.
Bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Tandoori Style Chicken
steps: Mix half the greek yogurt with garam masala, smoked paprika, garlic and ginger and coat the chicken thigh.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes, or overnight if you can.
Bake at 200 degrees for 25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve chicken over rice with cucumber, the rest of the greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Salmon with Soy and Ginger
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger, garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and green beans and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix spinach, ricotta and garlic in a bowl.
Fill the pasta tubes with the mix and lay them in an oven dish.
Pour crushed tomato over and drizzle with olive oil.
Top with mozzarella and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Lamb Keema and Peas
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, frozen peas, potato, cumin and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, egg, frozen peas and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Prawn Noodle Stir Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and egg and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter, soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Slow Beef Casserole
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, mushroom, carrot and sweet potato and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and vegetable stock and simmer for 50 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot, topped with parsley.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Fry chicken thigh, onion and carrot until golden, then stir in frozen peas, milk and vegetable stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the chicken mix and cover with pastry.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Tofu and Green Bean Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add tofu, green beans and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Salmon Burgers
steps: Flake the salmon and mix with breadcrumbs, egg and chopped spring onion.
Shape into 4 patties.
Fry in olive oil for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Warm the pita bread.
Fill with patties, cucumber and tomato, add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Crumbed Pork Patties with Slaw
steps: Shape the pork mince into 8 patties.
Dip the patties in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in olive oil for 5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Mix cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon into a slaw.
Serve the patties with the slaw.

name: Three Bean Chilli
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add black beans, kidney beans, chickpeas, corn and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice, topped with avocado.

name: Tomato and Basil Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomato and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with mozzarella and basil and serve hot.

name: Taco Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince with taco seasoning until browned.
Stir in black beans and corn.
Layer tortillas and beef mix in a pie dish.
Top with salsa and cheese and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve with sour cream.

name: Fish and Prawn Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Add white fish, prawns, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Lamb Pita Pockets
steps: Fry the lamb mince with cumin in olive oil until crisp at the edges.
Warm the pita bread.
Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion into a salad.
Fill pita bread with lamb and salad.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon and serve.

name: Pork and Cabbage Dumplings
steps: Mix flour with warm water into a dough, rest 20 minutes and roll out small circles.
Mix pork mince with finely chopped cabbage, ginger, garlic and spring onion.
Fill each circle, fold and pinch the edges closed.
Fry in olive oil for 3 minutes, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes.
Serve with soy sauce.

name: Beef and Capsicum Stir Fry
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and capsicum and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Sweet Chilli Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and broccoli and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey, chilli flakes and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Prawn Paella
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big wide pan.
Fry onion, capsicum and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add rice, smoked paprika and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Lay prawns and green beans on top, cover and cook 6 more minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tuna and Olive Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tuna, olives and cherry tomato and cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Pork Meatball Sandwich
steps: Mix pork mince, breadcrumbs, egg and garlic and roll into balls.
Fry the meatballs until browned all over.
Pour in tomato passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toast the bread slices.
Fill with meatballs and sauce, top with mozzarella and basil and serve.

name: Roast Style Chicken and Veg
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop onion, garlic, carrot and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 42 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Beef and Spinach Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Salmon Chowder
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add salmon, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the bread, topped with parsley.

name: Chicken Fajita Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Put chicken breast strips, capsicum and red onion on a tray with taco seasoning and olive oil.
Bake for 22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill tortillas with the chicken mix and top with sour cream, avocado and a squeeze of lime.

name: Fish Tikka
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix greek yogurt, garam masala, garlic and ginger and coat the white fish.
Rest the fish for 10 minutes.
Fry the fish for 8 minutes until golden, on a bed of spinach if you like.
Serve over rice with a squeeze of lemon and the spinach wilted through.

name: Slow Beef Ragu
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook red onion, celery and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips and carrot and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 45 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Greek Chicken and Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry chicken thigh and garlic until golden.
Add rice, oregano and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Stir in spinach and feta, add a squeeze of lemon and serve.

name: Prawn and Zucchini Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and zucchini and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Tofu Laksa Style Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Stir in curry paste and ginger.
Add tofu and capsicum and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lime and serve hot.

name: Pork Ragu Pasta
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta, topped with basil.

name: Mexican Chicken Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, black beans, corn and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with avocado, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Lamb and Feta Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add lamb mince, cherry tomato and spinach and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in oregano and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with feta and serve hot.

name: Beef Pilaf
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry beef mince and onion until browned.
Add rice, carrot, frozen peas, cumin and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with greek yogurt.

name: Herb Crumb Salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Mix breadcrumbs with parsley.
Press the crumb mix onto the salmon.
Bake the salmon with sweet potato wedges and olive oil for 18 minutes, adding the spinach for the last 3 minutes.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Chicken Gumbo Style Stew
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook celery and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the flour and rice.

name: Vegetable Korma
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, frozen peas, potato and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Menemen Style Eggs
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Fry onion and capsicum for 4 minutes.
Add chopped tomato and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs and stir them through gently until just set.
Serve with the bread.

name: Granola Crunch Bowl
steps: Spoon granola into two bowls.
Add greek yogurt on top.
Top with sliced banana and mixed berries.
Pour a little milk over each bowl.
Serve right away.

name: Smashed Avocado and Feta Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Smash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon.
Spread avocado thickly on each slice.
Top with cherry tomato, feta and chilli flakes.
Serve right away.

name: Cinnamon Roll Oatmeal
steps: Put the rolled oats and milk into a pot.
Cook on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the cinnamon and sugar.
Top with sliced banana and a small knob of butter and serve.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot and bring to a simmer.
Add corn, ginger and soy sauce and cook for 5 minutes.
Drizzle in the beaten egg, stirring slowly so it forms ribbons.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Churros Style Sticks
steps: Heat 150 ml water and the butter in a pot until the butter melts.
Stir in flour until a smooth dough ball forms, then cool a little.
Beat in the egg and pipe or spoon the dough into long sticks.
Fry in a hot pan for 3 minutes, turning until golden all over.
Roll in sugar and cinnamon and serve warm.

name: Green Eggs and Ham
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook spinach and ham for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and butter and serve.

name: Banana Coconut Smoothie
steps: Put banana, greek yogurt and coconut milk in a blender.
Add honey and cinnamon.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Ricotta and Berry Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread ricotta thickly on each slice.
Top with mixed berries.
Drizzle with honey and scatter basil.
Serve right away.

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, capsicum and mushroom for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with butter and garam masala and serve.

name: Savoury Breakfast Couscous
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and capsicum and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with feta and serve over the couscous.

name: Bacon and Egg Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Press the bread into a muffin tray to make cups.
Line each cup with bacon.
Crack an egg into each cup and scatter cheese and spring onion.
Bake for 14 minutes until the eggs are just set.

name: Classic French Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with butter, cheese, parsley and bread and serve.

name: Sweet Potato Toast with Egg
steps: Slice the sweet potato into thick planks and bake or toast until soft.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Smash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon.
Top the sweet potato planks with avocado and an egg.
Scatter chilli flakes and serve.

name: Banana Berry Parfait
steps: Layer greek yogurt in two glasses or bowls.
Add mixed berries and sliced banana.
Sprinkle chia seeds over each layer.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve.

name: Breakfast Ramen
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot and bring to a simmer.
Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside.
Cook the noodles in the stock for 4 minutes with the spinach.
Soft boil the eggs for 6 minutes, peel and halve.
Serve noodles in bowls with bacon, egg, spring onion and soy sauce.

name: Bubble and Squeak
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash roughly.
Mix potato with chopped cabbage, flour and beaten egg.
Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside.
Fry spoonfuls of the potato mix in butter for 4 minutes each side.
Serve with the bacon on top.

name: Omelette Wrap
steps: Whisk the eggs and cook a thin omelette in a big pan.
Lay ham, cheese, spinach and tomato down the middle.
Cook 1 more minute until the cheese starts to melt.
Roll the omelette up like a wrap.
Cut in half and serve.

name: Warm Berry Oats
steps: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cinnamon.
Top with mixed berries and banana and serve warm.

name: Greek Lamb Wrap
steps: Cook lamb mince until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with cucumber, tomato, feta and greek yogurt.
Add oregano and lemon and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add zucchini, capsicum, cherry tomato and frozen peas and cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and serve hot.

name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
steps: Coat chicken thigh with cumin and smoked paprika.
Fry the chicken for 10 minutes until cooked through, then slice it.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with chicken, cucumber and tomato.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon, roll up and serve.

name: Tuna and Chickpea Salad
steps: Chop red onion and celery.
Put tuna and chickpeas in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, parsley and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Bacon Lettuce Tomato Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
