Cook bacon until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop lettuce, tomato and spring onion.
Add mayonnaise and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Asian Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken thigh, corn and ginger and cook for 12 minutes.
Take the chicken out, shred it and put it back.
Add the noodles and spinach and cook 4 more minutes.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Falafel Burger
steps: Warm the falafel as the pack says.
Toast the bread.
Fill with falafel, tomato and lettuce.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve right away.

name: Caprese Couscous Salad
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cherry tomato.
Put mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and basil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Baked Samosas
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash roughly with frozen peas, onion, cumin and garam masala.
Mix flour with olive oil and warm water into a dough and roll out circles.
Fill each circle with the potato mix, fold and pinch the edges.
Bake at 190 degrees for 20 minutes until crisp and golden.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Veggie Quesadillas
steps: Fry capsicum and zucchini for 4 minutes until soft.
Lay capsicum, zucchini, corn, black beans and cheese over one half of each tortilla.
Fold the tortillas in half.
Cook in a dry hot pan for 3 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

name: Lentil and Carrot Patties
steps: Cook the lentils in water until soft, about 15 minutes, and drain well.
Mix lentils with grated carrot, breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and flour and shape into patties.
Fry the patties for 4 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Tomato and Cheese Tart
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out a pastry base.
Top with sliced tomato and mozzarella.
Bake for 20 minutes until the pastry is crisp.
Scatter basil and brush the edge with beaten egg, then serve.

name: Prawn Noodle Salad
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook prawns until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop cucumber, carrot and spring onion.
Add soy sauce, chilli flakes and lime and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chicken Laksa
steps: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a pot and bring to a simmer.
Stir in curry paste and add chicken breast and capsicum and cook for 8 minutes.
Take the chicken out, slice it and put it back.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lime.

name: Greek Meatball Soup
steps: Mix beef mince with rice, half the beaten egg, onion and parsley and roll small meatballs.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Drop the meatballs in and simmer for 20 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the egg with lemon juice, stir in a ladle of hot stock, then stir it back into the pot.
Serve hot, off the boil so the sauce stays silky.

name: Curried Chickpea Wrap
steps: Warm the chickpeas in a pan with the curry paste for 4 minutes.
Mash half the chickpeas roughly.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with chickpeas, spinach and cucumber.
Add greek yogurt, roll up and serve.

name: German Style Potato Salad
steps: Boil the potato until just soft, then slice it thickly.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix warm potato with mayonnaise, bacon and egg.
Top with spring onion and parsley and serve.

name: Greek Lemon Potatoes with Feta
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic and potato into chunks.
Add oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Pour the vegetable stock over everything.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Satay Wraps
steps: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it.
Mix peanut butter with soy sauce and a squeeze of lime into a sauce.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with chicken, cucumber, carrot and lettuce.
Drizzle with the satay sauce, roll up and serve.

name: Sweetcorn and Zucchini Cakes
steps: Mix corn, grated zucchini, beaten egg, flour and spring onion into a batter.
Fry spoonfuls in olive oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Antipasto Plate
steps: Toast the bread lightly and spread with pesto.
Arrange salami, mozzarella, olives and sliced tomato on a big plate.
Serve with the pesto toast.

name: Chicken Madras
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, garam masala and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Beef Tomato Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, green beans, capsicum and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Shepherds Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry lamb mince, onion, carrot and celery until browned, then stir in frozen peas, flour and vegetable stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with milk and butter.
Put the lamb mix in an oven dish and top with mash.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Pork Goulash
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, capsicum and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Fish Korma
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Chicken Jambalaya
steps: Heat a big pot and fry chicken thigh, onion and capsicum for 6 minutes.
Add rice, smoked paprika, chilli flakes and vegetable stock and stir well.
Stir in the corn and kidney beans.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Lay the prawns on top, cover and cook 4 more minutes.

name: Beef and Broccoli Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and broccoli and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Salmon and Broccoli Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Mix pasta with salmon chunks, broccoli, cream and garlic in an oven dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Crumbed Tofu with Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Dip tofu slices in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Mix cabbage with mayonnaise into a slaw.
Serve tofu over rice with slaw and soy sauce.

name: Kofta and Couscous Plate
steps: Mix lamb mince with cumin and oregano and shape into small kofta.
Fry the kofta in olive oil for 10 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
Pour hot water over the couscous and rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Serve kofta over couscous with feta and olives.
Scatter parsley and add a squeeze of lemon.

name: Prawn Bisque Style Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add prawns and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cream and butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the bread, topped with parsley.

name: Chicken and Dumpling Stew
steps: Heat the butter in a big pot and fry chicken thigh, onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock and add frozen peas and simmer 15 minutes.
Mix flour with milk into a soft dough and drop spoonfuls on top of the stew.
Cover and cook 12 more minutes until the dumplings puff up.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Beef and Sweet Potato Tagine
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, chickpeas, sweet potato, cinnamon and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the couscous.

name: Pork Bibimbap Style Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, egg, carrot and spinach and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Fragrant Baked Fish
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put garlic, ginger, spring onion, broccoli, white fish and rice in a big oven dish.
Pour over chilli flakes and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 17 minutes.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Paprikash
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Melt the butter and fry chicken thigh, onion and capsicum until golden.
Stir in smoked paprika and crushed tomato and simmer for 10 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the sour cream.
Serve over the pasta.

name: Mushroom Bolognese
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, celery and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add mushroom, spinach and oregano and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Salmon Noodle Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add salmon pieces, ginger and garlic and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the noodles and spinach and cook 4 more minutes.
Stir in soy sauce.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lime and serve hot.

name: Chicken Empanadas
steps: Fry chicken breast, capsicum and taco seasoning until cooked, then chop the chicken small and mix with corn and cheese.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out circles.
Fill each circle, fold and pinch the edges.
Brush with a little milk.
Bake at 190 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Beef and Mushroom Pie
steps: Fry beef mince, mushroom and onion until browned, then stir in frozen peas and vegetable stock and simmer 8 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the beef mix and cover with pastry.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 28 minutes until golden.

name: Tofu and Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add tofu, broccoli and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Stuffed Capsicums with Lamb
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry lamb mince and onion with oregano in olive oil until browned, then stir in rice and half the crushed tomato.
Fill the capsicum halves with the lamb mix, top with the rest of the crushed tomato and the feta.
Bake for 25 minutes until the capsicum is soft.

name: Chicken Curry Pie
steps: Fry chicken thigh and onion with curry paste for 6 minutes, then stir in coconut milk and frozen peas and simmer 8 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the chicken mix and cover with pastry.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 28 minutes until golden.

name: Philly Style Beef Sandwich
steps: Fry beef strips, capsicum and onion in butter until browned and soft.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Fill with the beef mix.
Top with cheese and let it melt for 1 minute.
Serve hot.

name: Pork and Noodle Stir Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, green beans and capsicum and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Lemon Garlic Chicken Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put garlic, green beans, chicken breast and potato in a big oven dish.
Cover and bake for 27 minutes.
Top with butter, lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Salmon and Rice Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cook the rice until just underdone and spread it on a tray.
Put salmon and broccoli on top with garlic and olive oil.
Bake for 16 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Serve with spring onion and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef Korma
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, green beans and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Prawn Fajitas
steps: Fry prawns, capsicum and onion with taco seasoning in olive oil until the prawns are pink.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the prawn mix.
Top with sour cream and avocado.
Serve with a squeeze of lime.

name: Tofu Burgers
steps: Mash the tofu with breadcrumbs, beaten egg, flour and soy sauce and shape into patties.
Fry the patties for 5 minutes each side until crisp.
Toast the bread.
Fill with patties, lettuce and tomato.
Add mayonnaise and serve.

name: Irish Style Lamb Stew
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook celery and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, carrot and potato and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 40 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the flour, topped with parsley.

name: Creamy Chicken Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Fry chicken breast and garlic until golden, then stir in cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Mix pasta and chicken mix in an oven dish.
Top with cheese and breadcrumbs and bake for 18 minutes.

name: White Fish Chowder
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, bacon, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot, topped with parsley.

name: Beef Fajita Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef mince, black beans and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in taco seasoning and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with cheese, sour cream and lime and serve over the rice.

name: Pork and Bean Stew
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, kidney beans, capsicum and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Broccoli Chicken Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Fry chicken thigh and garlic until golden, then stir in cream and broccoli.
Mix pasta and chicken mix in an oven dish.
Top with mozzarella and breadcrumbs and bake for 18 minutes.

name: Soy Glazed Salmon with Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and capsicum and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Beef Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg and onion and shape into a loaf.
Spread tomato passata over the top and bake for 40 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with butter and milk, and boil the green beans for 5 minutes.
Rest the loaf for 5 minutes, slice and serve with mash and green beans.

name: Prawn Skewers with Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Thread the prawns onto skewers with garlic and chilli flakes rubbed over.
Fry or grill the skewers in olive oil for 3 minutes each side until pink.
Chop cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve skewers over rice with salad, parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tofu and Potato Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add tofu, spinach, potato and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Lamb and Hummus Style Wraps
steps: Fry the lamb mince until crisp at the edges.
Mash the chickpeas with a squeeze of lemon into a rough spread.
Warm the tortillas and spread with the chickpea mix.
Fill with lamb, cucumber and tomato.
Add greek yogurt, roll up and serve.

name: Chicken Stroganoff
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, mushroom and spinach and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with sour cream and parsley and serve over the rice.

name: Baked Fish with Tomato and Olives
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Pour hot water over the couscous and rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Put white fish and capsicum in an oven dish with crushed tomato, olives and garlic and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 16 minutes until the fish flakes.
Scatter basil and serve over the couscous.

name: Western Scramble
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, capsicum, mushroom and spinach for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and butter and serve.

name: Pork and Egg Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Shape the pork mince into two thin patties and fry until cooked through.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast the bread.
Fill with patties, egg and cheese.
Add mayonnaise and serve.

name: Toasted Oat Muesli Bowl
steps: Toast the rolled oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Spoon greek yogurt into two bowls.
Top with oats, sliced banana and chia seeds.
Add a splash of milk and a drizzle of honey.

name: Breakfast Tostada
steps: Bake or dry fry the tortillas until crisp.
Mash the black beans and warm them through.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Spread beans on the tostadas and top with egg and cheese.
Add salsa and avocado and serve.

name: Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
steps: Mix rolled oats, peanut butter, greek yogurt and chia seeds in a bowl or jar.
Rest in the fridge overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with mixed berries.
Serve cold.

name: Egg and Ham Quesadilla
steps: Scramble the eggs softly with the mushroom and spinach.
Lay egg and ham over one half of each tortilla.
Top with cheese and fold the tortillas in half.
Cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
Serve right away.

name: Banana and Peanut French Toast
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with the eggs.
Dip the bread slices in the mix.
Fry in butter for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Spread with peanut butter.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Savoury Oat Bowl
steps: Put the rolled oats and vegetable stock into a pot.
Cook on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Stir in spinach and cheese until the spinach wilts.
Top with a soft fried egg and spring onion and serve.

name: Veggie Breakfast Burrito
steps: Fry the mushroom until golden.
Scramble the eggs with spinach and black beans.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the egg mix and cheese.
Roll up tight and serve.

name: Bean and Egg Breakfast Pots
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix black beans, crushed tomato, corn and smoked paprika in an oven dish.
Make little wells and crack the eggs in.
Scatter cheese over the top.
Bake for 12 minutes and serve with warm tortilla pieces for dipping.

name: Oat and Banana Slice
steps: Heat the oven to 170 degrees.
Mash the bananas and mix with beaten egg, honey and cinnamon.
Stir in the rolled oats and flour.
Press into a lined tray and scatter mixed berries on top.
Bake for 18 minutes, cool, then cut into bars.

name: Baked Custard Oats
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Whisk milk, eggs, sugar and cinnamon.
Stir in rolled oats and sliced banana.
Pour into an oven dish.
Bake for 25 minutes until set like a soft custard.

name: Chinese Tomato Eggs
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Cook chopped tomato for 4 minutes until it makes a sauce.
Add soy sauce and sugar.
Pour in the beaten egg and stir gently until just set.
Top with spring onion and serve.

name: Potato and Zucchini Rosti
steps: Grate the potato and zucchini and squeeze out the extra water.
Mix with beaten egg, flour and spring onion.
Fry flat spoonfuls in olive oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Breakfast Veggie Loaf
steps: Heat the oven to 170 degrees.
Mix flour and baking powder in a big bowl.
Stir in beaten egg, milk, grated zucchini and carrot, ham and cheese.
Pour into a lined loaf tin.
Bake for 28 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

name: Yogurt Custard Toast
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Whisk greek yogurt, egg, honey and cinnamon.
Press a well into each bread slice and fill with the yogurt mix.
Top with mixed berries.
Bake for 12 minutes until the custard is just set.

name: Creamy Mushroom Toast
steps: Fry mushroom and garlic until golden.
Pour in the cream and simmer for 3 minutes until thick.
Stir in spinach until it wilts.
Toast the bread.
Pile the mushrooms on toast and scatter parmesan.

name: Halloumi Breakfast Salad
steps: Cook egg until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop cherry tomato, cucumber and lettuce.
Put halloumi in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Carrot Cake Smoothie
steps: Put banana, greek yogurt and milk in a blender.
Add cinnamon, honey and carrot.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Eggs Florentine Style
steps: Toast the bread.
Wilt the spinach in a pan and put it on the toast.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes.
Put eggs on the spinach.
Melt butter with a squeeze of lemon and cheese and pour over, then serve.

name: Beans and Bacon Breakfast Bowl
steps: Fry the potato cubes in butter until crisp and golden.
Fry the bacon and warm the black beans through.
Scramble or fry the eggs and wilt the spinach.
Grill the tomato.
Put everything in two bowls and serve.

name: Chicken Club Wrap
steps: Cook chicken breast and bacon until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Add mayonnaise and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Taco Salad
steps: Fry the beef mince until browned and crisp at the edges.
Bake the tortilla until crisp, then break it into pieces.
Put lettuce in a big bowl with beef, tomato, corn and black beans.
Add cheese and tortilla pieces.
Top with sour cream and salsa and toss well.

name: Cobb Salad
steps: Cook chicken breast, egg and bacon until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop lettuce, tomato and avocado.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Buffalo Style Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Bake the chicken breast strips for 18 minutes until cooked through.
Melt butter with chilli flakes and garlic and toss the chicken through it.
Mix greek yogurt with a squeeze of lemon into a dip.
Serve the chicken with celery sticks and the dip.

name: Chicken and Sweetcorn Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, corn, carrot and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with parsley.

name: Mexican Bean Soup
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add kidney beans, black beans, capsicum and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Sloppy Joes
steps: Fry beef mince, onion and capsicum until browned.
Stir in tomato passata and honey and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Toast the bread.
Pile the beef mix on the toast.
Top with cheese and let it melt, then serve.

name: Ranch Style Chicken Salad
steps: Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop lettuce, cucumber and tomato.
Put greek yogurt in a big bowl.
Add mayonnaise, parsley and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Loaded Baked Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees and bake the potato for 35 minutes until soft inside.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Split the potato and fluff the inside with butter.
Fill with bacon, corn and cheese.
Top with sour cream and spring onion and serve.

name: Pulled Chicken Sandwich
steps: Cook the chicken thigh in simmering water for 15 minutes, then shred it.
Mix the chicken with honey and smoked paprika and warm it through.
Mix cabbage with mayonnaise into a slaw.
Toast the bread.
Fill with chicken, slaw and cheese and serve.

name: Charred Corn and Feta Salad
steps: Fry the corn in a dry hot pan until it chars at the edges.
Tip into a bowl and cool a little.
Stir in mayonnaise, feta and chilli flakes.
Add a squeeze of lime and the parsley.
Serve warm or cold.

name: Chicken Chimichanga
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the chicken breast until cooked, then chop it small.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, rice, black beans and cheese and roll up tight.
Fry seam side down in olive oil until crisp and golden all over.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: Tuna Melt Wrap
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise, chopped celery and spring onion.
Fill the tortillas and top with cheese.
Roll up tight.
Cook in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
Serve right away.

name: Loaded Potato Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add bacon and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cheese and sour cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Veggie Nachos
steps: Bake the tortillas until crisp, then break into chips.
Fry capsicum, zucchini and corn for 5 minutes.
Put chips on a tray with the veg, kidney beans and cheese.
Bake for 6 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with salsa and greek yogurt and serve.

name: Greek Chicken Couscous Bowl
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop tomato, capsicum and red onion.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, lemon and parsley and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chicken Torta Style Sandwich
steps: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it.
Mash the black beans and spread on the bread.
Toast the bread lightly.
Fill with chicken, capsicum, lettuce and tomato.
Add salsa and serve.

name: Corn and Bacon Fritters
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add bacon, egg, corn and flour and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with cheese and serve hot.

name: Salmon and Potato Salad
steps: Cook salmon and egg until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop green beans, lettuce and spring onion.
Put potato in a big bowl.
Add mayonnaise and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Egg Salad Wrap
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix egg with mayonnaise and chilli flakes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the egg mix, cucumber and lettuce.
Roll up and serve.

name: Beef Enchilada Wraps
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince with taco seasoning until browned and stir in black beans.
Fill the tortillas, roll up and put in an oven dish.
Pour tomato passata over and scatter cheese.
Bake for 12 minutes and serve with sour cream.

name: Chilli Prawn Tacos
steps: Fry the prawns until pink, about 4 minutes.
Mix mayonnaise with chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, prawns and cheese.
Drizzle with the chilli mayo and serve.

name: Chicken Pesto Sandwich
steps: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it.
Spread pesto on the bread.
Toast the sandwiches lightly so the mozzarella melts.
Fill with chicken, tomato and spinach.
Serve warm.

name: Lentil Soup with Yogurt and Cumin
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, carrot and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: BLAT Wrap
steps: Cook bacon until done.
Cook the egg to your liking.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with lettuce, tomato and avocado.
Serve right away.

name: Greek Chicken Wrap
steps: Cook chicken breast until done.
Warm the tortilla.
Fill with cucumber, tomato, lettuce, greek yogurt and feta.
Add oregano and lemon and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: BBQ Style Chicken Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Mix tomato passata, honey, smoked paprika and garlic into a sauce.
Put chicken thigh and potato on a tray with olive oil and pour the sauce over.
Bake for 30 minutes until sticky and cooked through.
Serve with the corn, boiled, on the side.

name: Beef Meatball Subs with Cheese
steps: Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, garlic and oregano and roll into balls.
Fry the meatballs until browned all over.
Pour in tomato passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toast the bread.
Fill with meatballs and sauce, top with cheese and serve.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and spinach and cook for 13 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with butter, parmesan, lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Smoky Beef Burritos
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry beef strips, capsicum and onion with smoked paprika until browned.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with rice, beef mix and cheese.
Add sour cream, roll up tight and serve.

name: Beef Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince and onion with cumin until browned.
Fill the tortillas, roll up and put in an oven dish.
Pour tomato passata over and scatter cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes and serve with sour cream.

name: Pork Carnitas Style Tacos
steps: Fry the pork mince on high heat until crisp and browned at the edges.
Chop the onion finely.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with pork, cabbage and onion.
Top with sour cream and salsa and serve with a wedge of lime.

name: White Fish Burgers
steps: Flake the white fish and mix with breadcrumbs and beaten egg and shape into patties.
Fry the patties for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Bake or fry the potato into chunky chips.
Toast the bread.
Fill with patties, lettuce and mayonnaise, add a squeeze of lemon and serve with the chips.

name: Country Fried Beef
steps: Dip beef strips in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Whisk a spoon of flour into the milk, heat with butter until thick, for a gravy.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve the beef with potato, green beans and gravy.

name: Prawn Po Boy Sandwich
steps: Toss the prawns in flour and fry until crisp and pink.
Toast the bread.
Fill with lettuce, tomato and prawns.
Mix mayonnaise with chilli flakes and a squeeze of lemon and drizzle over.
Serve right away.

name: Honey BBQ Pork
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and corn and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey, smoked paprika and tomato passata and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Honey Soy Chicken Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and pour over the chicken thigh on a tray.
Bake for 28 minutes until sticky and cooked through.
Serve over rice with spring onion.

name: Beef Pot Roast
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, carrot and potato and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and tomato passata and simmer for 50 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the flour, topped with parsley.

name: Chicken and Stuffing Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix breadcrumbs with melted butter, chopped onion, celery and parsley into a stuffing.
Put chicken thigh in an oven dish and cover with the stuffing.
Bake for 35 minutes with potato wedges, adding the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

name: Cajun Style Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, capsicum and corn and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Seafood Gumbo
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook celery and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add prawns, white fish, capsicum and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the flour and rice.

name: Prawn Creole
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, celery, garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and capsicum and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Crispy Chicken Tenders
steps: Dip chicken breast strips in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Bake or fry the potato into chunky chips and boil the corn.
Mix honey into the mayonnaise for a dip.
Serve the tenders with chips, corn and the dip.

name: Beef Chilli Mac
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, kidney beans and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cheese and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Pork Stroganoff
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and mushroom and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with sour cream, butter and parsley and serve over the pasta.

name: Fish and Chips Style Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cut the potato into chips and bake for 25 minutes.
Dip white fish in beaten egg, then breadcrumbs, and add to the tray for the last 15 minutes.
Boil the frozen peas.
Serve with lemon and mayonnaise.

name: Chicken Divan Style Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat until thick with the butter, then stir in half the cheese.
Put chicken breast and broccoli in an oven dish and pour the sauce over.
Top with breadcrumbs and the rest of the cheese and bake for 22 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Beef Goulash
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, capsicum, carrot, potato and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Salmon Parcels
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Mix flaked salmon with spinach and cream.
Fill pastry parcels with the salmon mix and pinch the edges.
Brush with beaten egg and bake for 22 minutes.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Chicken Kiev Style
steps: Mix butter with garlic and parsley and chill until firm.
Cut a pocket in each chicken breast and fill with the garlic butter.
Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with potato, green beans and a wedge of lemon.

name: Nacho Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince until browned and stir in black beans and corn.
Layer torn tortilla and beef mix in a pie dish.
Top with salsa and cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes and serve with sour cream and avocado.

name: Pork Al Pastor Style
steps: Fry pork mince, onion and capsicum with chilli flakes until crisp at the edges.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the pork mix and cheese.
Top with salsa.
Serve with a wedge of lime.

name: Chicken Taco Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, black beans, corn and taco seasoning and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cheese and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the tortilla.

name: Beef Fajitas
steps: Fry beef strips, capsicum and onion with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the beef mix and cheese.
Add sour cream.
Serve with a wedge of lime.

name: Pork Chile Verde Style
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, capsicum, spinach and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Pork Pozole Style Stew
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, corn, cabbage and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Chicken Tinga
steps: Simmer the chicken thigh in water for 15 minutes, then shred it.
Fry onion and garlic, add crushed tomato and chilli flakes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir the chicken through the sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill with chicken and cheese.
Top with sour cream and serve with a wedge of lime.

name: Beef Picadillo
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, carrot, frozen peas, olives and potato and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Fish Veracruz Style
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add white fish, capsicum and olives and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Prawn Diabla Style
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and parsley and serve over the rice.

name: Mexican Style Chicken Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry chicken thigh and onion for 6 minutes.
Add rice, capsicum, corn, crushed tomato, cumin and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with a squeeze of lime.

name: Cornbread Style Beef Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince with taco seasoning until browned and stir in black beans.
Mix flour, corn, melted butter and milk into a thick batter.
Put the beef mix in a pie dish and spread the batter over.
Scatter cheese and bake for 22 minutes until golden.

name: Salmon Tacos
steps: Fry the salmon until just cooked, then flake it.
Mix mayonnaise with chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, cucumber and salmon.
Drizzle with the chilli mayo and serve.

name: White Chicken Chilli
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, black beans, corn and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Beef Quesadillas
steps: Fry beef mince, capsicum and onion until browned.
Lay beef and cheese over one half of each tortilla.
Fold the tortillas in half.
Cook in a dry hot pan for 3 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 220 degrees.
Spread salsa over the pizza base.
Top with chicken breast, corn, red onion and smoked paprika.
Scatter mozzarella on top.
Bake for 21 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Serve hot.

name: Beef and Capsicum Pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 220 degrees.
Spread salsa over the pizza base.
Top with beef mince, capsicum, onion and oregano.
Scatter mozzarella on top.
Bake for 21 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Serve hot.

name: Tuna and Corn Rice Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix rice with tuna, corn, frozen peas and cream in an oven dish.
Top with cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake for 18 minutes until golden.

name: Herb Roast Chicken Dinner
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop onion, garlic, green beans, potato and pumpkin into chunks.
Add chicken thigh to the tray.
Bake for 42 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with butter, parsley and lemon and serve hot.

name: Poha Style Rice Breakfast
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and frozen peas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the rice.

name: Upma Style Couscous
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add carrot and frozen peas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the couscous.

name: Aloo Paratha Style Flatbreads
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash with cumin and chilli flakes.
Mix flour with warm water into a dough and roll out small circles.
Fill each circle with potato mix, fold and roll flat again.
Fry in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes each side.
Brush with butter and serve with greek yogurt.

name: Egg Curry with Toast
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and halve.
Melt the butter and fry onion until soft.
Add chopped tomato and curry paste and cook for 5 minutes into a sauce.
Add the eggs and warm through.
Toast the bread and serve the eggs in sauce on top.

name: Greek Breakfast Plate
steps: Boil or fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast the bread and drizzle with olive oil.
Arrange tomato, cucumber, olives and feta on two plates.
Add the eggs and bread.
Scatter oregano and serve.

name: Strapatsada
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Cook chopped tomato for 6 minutes until it thickens.
Whisk the eggs and stir them through the tomato until just set.
Scatter feta and oregano.
Serve with the bread.

name: Italian Breakfast Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Top toast with sliced tomato and mozzarella.
Add a fried egg to each plate.
Scatter basil and serve.

name: Farmhouse Frittata
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Cook onion, zucchini and capsicum for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and parsley and serve.

name: Masala Beans on Toast
steps: Melt the butter and fry onion with cumin and garam masala for 3 minutes.
Add kidney beans and a splash of water and simmer for 5 minutes, mashing a few beans.
Toast the bread.
Pile the beans on toast.
Scatter cheese and serve.

name: Tomato Toast and Eggs
steps: Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic.
Grate or finely chop the tomato and pile it on the toast with a drizzle of olive oil.
Fry the eggs and the ham.
Put eggs on the toast.
Serve right away.

name: Honey Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon greek yogurt into two bowls.
Top with sliced banana and mixed berries.
Scatter granola over the top.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Serve right away.

name: Cilbir Eggs
steps: Spread greek yogurt mixed with crushed garlic on two plates.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes.
Put the eggs on the yogurt.
Melt butter with chilli flakes and pour over.
Scatter parsley and serve with the bread.

name: Indian Spiced Oats
steps: Put the rolled oats and vegetable stock into a pot.
Add frozen peas, grated carrot, cumin and ginger.
Cook on low heat for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Breakfast Bread Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Tear the bread into an oven dish with ham and chopped tomato.
Whisk eggs and milk and pour over.
Scatter cheese on top.
Bake for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Lemon Ricotta Crepes
steps: Whisk flour, eggs and milk into a thin batter.
Fry thin crepes in butter for 1 minute each side.
Spread ricotta over each crepe.
Add a squeeze of lemon and roll up.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Green Shakshuka
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Wilt the spinach with garlic in an oven safe pan.
Stir in the cream.
Make little wells and crack the eggs in, then scatter feta.
Bake for 10 minutes and serve with the bread.

name: Greek Rice Pudding
steps: Put the rice and milk into a pot.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is soft and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and a little lemon zest.
Dust with cinnamon and serve warm or cold.

name: Johnny Cakes
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, beaten egg and milk into a batter and stir in the corn.
Fry spoonfuls in butter for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve warm with honey.

name: Mushroom and Egg Tartine
steps: Fry mushroom and garlic in butter until golden.
Toast the bread.
Scramble or fry the eggs.
Pile mushrooms and egg on the toast.
Scatter cheese and serve.

name: Chai Style Oats
steps: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cinnamon, sugar and ginger.
Top with banana and serve warm.

name: Breakfast Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Scramble the eggs softly.
Fill the tortillas with egg, black beans and half the cheese and roll up in an oven dish.
Pour salsa over and scatter the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 12 minutes and serve with sour cream.

name: Avgolemono Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken thigh and carrot and cook for 15 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Add the pasta and cook for 8 minutes.
Whisk egg with lemon juice, stir in a ladle of hot stock, then stir it back into the pot.
Top with spring onion and serve hot, off the boil.

name: Gemista Stuffed Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Cut the tops off the tomato and capsicum and scoop out the middles.
Mix rice with chopped onion, parsley, olive oil and the scooped tomato flesh.
Fill the vegetables, top with feta and bake for 25 minutes.

name: Briam
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put onion, garlic, zucchini, tomato, capsicum and potato in a big oven dish.
Pour over oregano and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 32 minutes.
Top with feta and serve hot.

name: Keftedes with Pita
steps: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and oregano and shape into small balls.
Fry the keftedes for 10 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
Warm the pita bread.
Chop cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve keftedes in pita with salad and greek yogurt.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Hand Pies
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Wilt the spinach and mix with feta, ricotta and beaten egg.
Mix flour with olive oil and warm water into a dough and roll out circles.
Fill each circle, fold and pinch the edges.
Bake for 20 minutes until crisp and golden.

name: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix pork mince with beaten egg and roll tiny meatballs.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add meatballs, carrot, onion and pasta and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until it wilts.
Serve with parmesan on top.

name: Panzanella
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, olives and red onion.
Put bread and mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and basil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic, carrot and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomato and vegetable stock and add the kidney beans.
Add the pasta and simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is soft.
Serve with parmesan on top.

name: Italian Rice Salad
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop corn, frozen peas, capsicum and olives.
Put tuna in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Chana Masala with Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Aloo Gobi Wrap
steps: Fry potato and cauliflower with cumin and garam masala until soft and golden at the edges.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the potato mix and spinach.
Add greek yogurt, roll up and serve.

name: Sambar Style Lentils
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, carrot, potato and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Vegetable Pakora
steps: Mix sliced onion, capsicum and zucchini with flour, beaten egg, cumin and garam masala into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in olive oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Raita and Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix greek yogurt with grated cucumber, cumin and a squeeze of lemon into a raita.
Warm the chickpeas through.
Serve rice topped with chickpeas, chopped tomato and the raita.

name: Masala Fries with Yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Cut the potato into fries and toss with olive oil, garam masala and chilli flakes.
Bake for 25 minutes until crisp.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Greek Fries
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Put potato in a big oven dish.
Pour over oregano and olive oil.
Cover and bake for 22 minutes.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Village Salad with Bread
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, olives, capsicum and red onion.
Put bread and feta in a big bowl.
Add oregano and olive oil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Greek Chicken and Lemon Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic and potato into chunks.
Add chicken breast and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Pour the vegetable stock over everything.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Zucchini Parmigiana
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Fry zucchini slices in olive oil until golden.
Layer zucchini, crushed tomato, mozzarella and breadcrumbs in an oven dish.
Top with parmesan.
Bake for 20 minutes and scatter basil.

name: Frittata Sandwich
steps: Cook a spinach, egg and cheese frittata in a pan until set.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Cut the frittata to fit and fill the sandwiches.
Add sliced tomato and serve.

name: Couscous and Mozzarella Salad
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cucumber, cherry tomato and capsicum.
Put mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, lemon and basil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Crispy Rice Cakes
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says and cool it a little.
Mix rice with beaten egg, cheese, spring onion and flour and shape into cakes.
Fry for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Serve with salsa.

name: Greek Bean Plaki
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix kidney beans, crushed tomato, onion, garlic, oregano and olive oil in an oven dish.
Scatter feta on top.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve with the bread.

name: Chicken Stifado
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, red onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and cinnamon and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in feta and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Beef Pastitsio
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Fry beef mince and onion with cinnamon, then stir in crushed tomato and simmer 8 minutes.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat with the butter until thick, then stir in beaten egg and half the cheese.
Layer pasta and beef in an oven dish, pour the sauce over, top with the rest of the cheese and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Greek Lamb and Potato Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, onion and potato into chunks.
Add lamb mince and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Lemonato
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry chicken thigh and garlic until golden.
Add potato, oregano and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add green beans for the last 8 minutes and finish with plenty of lemon.

name: Greek Pork Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, red onion, capsicum and potato into chunks.
Add pork mince and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with greek yogurt and lemon and serve hot.

name: Vegetable Moussaka
steps: Cook the lentils in water until soft, about 20 minutes, and drain.
Fry onion in the olive oil, then stir in lentils, crushed tomato and cinnamon and simmer 8 minutes.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Layer potato and zucchini slices with the lentil mix in an oven dish and pour the sauce over.
Top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes.

name: Greek Meatball Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and oregano and roll into balls, then fry until browned.
Mix pasta, meatballs, tomato passata and spinach in an oven dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Saltimbocca Style
steps: Top each chicken breast with ham and mozzarella and hold with a toothpick if you have one.
Fry in butter for 6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Scatter parsley over the chicken.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Beef Pizzaiola
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and capsicum and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in oregano and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with mozzarella and serve over the pasta.

name: Pork Piccata Style
steps: Shape the pork mince into thin patties and dip in flour, then beaten egg.
Fry in butter for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Cook the pasta as the pack says, adding green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Add a squeeze of lemon and the parsley to the pan and swirl.
Serve the pork over the pasta and beans.

name: Chicken in Mushroom Sauce
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and mushroom and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and parsley and serve over the pasta.

name: Tuna Puttanesca
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tuna and olives and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato and warm through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss everything together.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Amatriciana
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add bacon and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato and warm through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and serve hot.

name: Creamy Carbonara with Peas
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add bacon, egg and frozen peas and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and serve hot.

name: Pumpkin Risotto Style Rice
steps: Melt the butter in a big pot and fry onion, garlic and pumpkin for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is soft, about 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach and parmesan.
Rest 2 minutes and serve.

name: Italian Beef Stew
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, carrot, frozen peas and potato and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with parsley.

name: Chicken Vindaloo
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum, potato, garam masala, chilli flakes and cumin and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Lamb Bhuna
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, tomato, capsicum and garam masala and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef Jalfrezi
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, capsicum and tomato and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Chicken Karahi Style
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and tomato and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and cumin and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and parsley and serve over the rice.

name: Chettinad Style Prawn Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add prawns, tomato, garam masala and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Goan Style Fish Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, tomato, garam masala and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Saag Chicken
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Saag Halloumi
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the halloumi until golden and set aside.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger, then add spinach and garam masala and cook until the spinach wilts.
Stir in the cream.
Serve spinach over rice with halloumi on top.

name: Aloo Matar
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add frozen peas, potato, cumin and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Vegetable Sabzi
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, carrot, frozen peas, potato, cumin and garam masala and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Khichdi
steps: Melt the butter in a big pot and fry cumin and ginger for 1 minute.
Add rice, lentils, carrot and frozen peas with 900 ml water.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until soft and porridge like.
Rest 5 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken Pulao
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry chicken thigh and onion until golden.
Add rice, potato, frozen peas, cumin and garam masala with 600 ml water and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Seekh Kebab Style Lamb
steps: Mix lamb mince with grated onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala and chilli flakes and shape into long kebabs.
Fry the kebabs for 10 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve kebabs over rice with cucumber.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken Handi Style
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, capsicum, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Pork Balti Style
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, capsicum and tomato and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with greek yogurt and serve over the rice.

name: Tofu Makhani Style
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add tofu, frozen peas and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Dal Makhani Style
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, kidney beans and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in butter and cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Chana Pulao
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry onion with cumin and garam masala for 3 minutes.
Add rice, chickpeas, frozen peas and 600 ml water and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 16 minutes until the rice is soft.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Kerala Style Fish Curry
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook ginger and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, capsicum and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Pork Meatballs with Spaghetti
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, egg, breadcrumbs and oregano and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the spaghetti.

name: Chicken Arrabbiata Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and basil and serve hot.

name: Tuna and Pea Rice
steps: Melt the butter in a big pot and fry onion for 4 minutes.
Add rice and vegetable stock and stir well.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in tuna, frozen peas and parmesan.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Lamb Ragu with Pasta
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, carrot and spinach and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Greek Style Chicken and Pasta
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry chicken thigh, onion and garlic until golden.
Pour in crushed tomato and 500 ml water and add oregano.
Add the pasta and simmer for 12 minutes until the pasta is soft.
Scatter feta and serve.

name: Italian Herb Chicken Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, cherry tomato, zucchini and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Chicken Congee
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot with the rice, ginger and garlic and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice breaks down and turns creamy.
Shred in the chicken breast for the last 8 minutes.
Stir in spinach and soy sauce.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Tamago Egg Sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and mash.
Mix egg with mayonnaise, milk and sugar.
Pile the egg mix onto the bread.
Top with the second slices, press lightly and cut.
Serve right away.

name: Kaya Toast with Eggs
steps: Heat coconut milk and sugar in a small pot, then whisk in 2 beaten eggs and cook gently until thick like jam.
Toast the bread and spread with butter and the coconut jam.
Soft boil the other eggs for 6 minutes.
Serve the toast with the soft eggs for dipping.

name: Roti Style Flatbread with Eggs
steps: Mix flour with warm water into a dough, roll out flatbreads and fry in a dry pan until puffed and spotted.
Scramble the eggs with curry paste and spinach.
Brush the flatbreads with butter.
Serve eggs on the flatbreads with greek yogurt.

name: Nasi Lemak Style Plate
steps: Cook the rice in coconut milk and water until soft.
Fry the chicken thigh until golden and cooked through.
Boil or fry the eggs.
Serve rice with chicken, egg and cucumber slices.
Scatter chilli flakes and add a wedge of lime.

name: Okayu Rice Porridge
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot with the rice and ginger and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 22 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and porridge like.
Beat the eggs and stir them through off the heat.
Add soy sauce.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Pikelets
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add egg and flour and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in baking powder, sugar, honey and milk and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and banana and serve hot.

name: Rissoles and Eggs
steps: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, 1 beaten egg and grated onion and shape into rissoles.
Fry the rissoles for 5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Fry the tomato and the other eggs in butter.
Toast the bread.
Serve rissoles and eggs on toast with the tomato.

name: Salmon Potato Cakes
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash roughly.
Mix potato with flaked salmon, beaten egg, flour and spring onion and shape into cakes.
Fry for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Soy Greens with Fried Eggs
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add egg and spinach and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Soy Marinated Eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and peel.
Warm soy sauce, sugar, ginger and a splash of water and pour over the eggs.
Rest the eggs in the mix for at least 10 minutes, turning once.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve eggs halved over rice with spring onion.

name: Berry Milk Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and spread lightly with butter.
Spread greek yogurt thickly on each slice.
Top with mixed berries.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Thai Style Omelette and Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Breakfast Banh Mi Style
steps: Fry the eggs and warm the ham.
Toast the bread lightly.
Spread mayonnaise mixed with chilli flakes on the bread.
Fill with egg, ham, grated carrot and cucumber.
Serve right away.

name: Japanese Breakfast Plate
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Grill or fry the salmon until just cooked.
Roll a thin omelette from the eggs and slice it.
Wilt the spinach.
Serve rice with salmon, egg slices and spinach, with soy sauce and spring onion.

name: Smashed Peas on Toast with Egg
steps: Cook the frozen peas for 3 minutes and smash roughly with a squeeze of lemon.
Toast the bread.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Pile peas on toast and top with an egg.
Scatter feta and chilli flakes and serve.

name: Potato Scones
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash smooth.
Mix potato with flour, melted butter, cheese and spring onion into a dough.
Roll out and cut into rounds.
Fry for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Fry the eggs and serve on top.

name: Breakfast Mie Goreng
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add egg, ham and capsicum and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Pan
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add egg, ham, capsicum and sweet potato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with feta and serve hot.

name: Prawn Toast
steps: Chop the prawns finely and mix with beaten egg, spring onion, ginger and soy sauce.
Spread the mix thickly on the bread.
Fry prawn side down in olive oil for 3 minutes until crisp and pink.
Turn and fry 1 more minute.
Cut into triangles and serve.

name: Bacon and Egg Roll
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast the bread rolls lightly.
Fill with bacon, egg, cheese and lettuce.
Add salsa and serve.

name: Dim Sim Style Dumplings
steps: Mix flour with warm water into a dough, rest 15 minutes and roll out circles.
Mix pork mince with finely chopped cabbage, ginger and spring onion.
Fill each circle, fold and pinch the edges.
Put in a steamer or a pan with a little water and a lid and steam for 10 minutes.
Serve with soy sauce.

name: San Choy Bow
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry pork mince with ginger until browned and crisp at the edges.
Stir in grated carrot, spring onion, soy sauce and chilli flakes.
Spoon pork and rice into lettuce leaves.
Roll up and eat with your hands.

name: Gado Gado
steps: Boil the potato, green beans and cabbage until just soft.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and halve.
Mix peanut butter with soy sauce, a squeeze of lime and a little warm water into a sauce.
Arrange potato, beans, cabbage, carrot, tofu and egg on plates.
Pour the peanut sauce over and serve.

name: Soto Ayam Style Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken breast, ginger, garlic and curry paste and cook for 12 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Add the noodles and cabbage and cook 4 more minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and halve.
Serve soup with egg, spring onion and a squeeze of lime.

name: Bakso Style Meatball Soup
steps: Mix beef mince with half the garlic and ginger and roll small meatballs.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add meatballs and the rest of the garlic and ginger and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the noodles and spinach and cook 4 more minutes.
Serve with boiled egg halves, spring onion and soy sauce.

name: Tom Kha Style Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook ginger, garlic and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast and mushroom and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Larb Style Pork Salad
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the pork mince until browned and just cooked.
Take off the heat and stir in red onion, spring onion, chilli flakes and plenty of lime juice.
Put lettuce and cucumber in bowls.
Top with pork and serve with the rice.

name: Pad See Ew Style Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, egg and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Krapow Style Basil Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and egg and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes, soy sauce and sugar and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with basil and serve over the rice.

name: Hainanese Style Chicken Rice
steps: Poach the chicken thigh gently in water with ginger and garlic for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in some of the chicken water.
Slice the chicken and put it over the rice.
Top with spring onion and cucumber.
Serve with soy sauce and chilli flakes mixed for dipping.

name: Char Siu Style Pork
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and cucumber and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Okonomiyaki
steps: Mix shredded cabbage with flour, beaten eggs and spring onion into a thick batter.
Fry big spoonfuls in a pan for 4 minutes each side until golden, with bacon on top.
Flip once more so the bacon crisps.
Drizzle with mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Serve hot.

name: Gyoza Style Dumplings
steps: Mix flour with warm water into a dough, rest 15 minutes and roll out small circles.
Mix pork mince with ginger, garlic and spring onion.
Fill each circle, fold and pinch the edges.
Fry in olive oil for 3 minutes, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes.
Serve with soy sauce.

name: Karaage Style Chicken
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, egg, cabbage and flour and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and mayonnaise and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Yakitori Style Skewers
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Thread chicken thigh pieces and capsicum onto skewers with spring onion pieces.
Mix soy sauce and honey into a glaze.
Fry or grill the skewers for 10 minutes, brushing with glaze, until shiny and cooked through.
Serve over rice.

name: Oyako Style Chicken Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Simmer chicken thigh and onion in soy sauce, sugar and a little water for 8 minutes.
Pour beaten egg over the chicken and cook gently until just set.
Serve over rice.
Top with spring onion.

name: Rissoles with Gravy and Mash
steps: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and grated onion and shape into rissoles.
Fry the rissoles for 6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with milk and butter.
Whisk flour into the vegetable stock, heat until thick, for a gravy.
Serve rissoles with mash, frozen peas boiled, and the gravy.

name: Sausage Sizzle Style Sandwich
steps: Shape the pork mince into two long sausage patties and fry until cooked through.
Fry the onion in butter until soft and sweet.
Toast the bread.
Fill with patties, onion and cheese.
Add salsa and serve.

name: Seafood Basket
steps: Dip white fish pieces and prawns in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes until crisp and golden.
Fry the potato into chunky chips.
Serve the seafood with chips, lettuce and mayonnaise.
Add a wedge of lemon.

name: Salt and Pepper Prawns
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, capsicum and flour and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the rice.

name: Garlic Prawns
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, cherry tomato and bread and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with butter, lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Fishermans Pie
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash with half the milk and half the butter.
Whisk flour into the rest of the milk, heat with the rest of the butter until thick.
Flake white fish and prawns through the sauce with frozen peas and corn.
Put in an oven dish and top with mash, roughing it with beaten egg brushed over.
Bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Tuna and Sweet Potato Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Slice the sweet potato thinly and layer in an oven dish with tuna and corn.
Pour cream over.
Top with cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden and soft.

name: Impossible Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 170 degrees.
Whisk flour, eggs and milk into a batter.
Stir in cheese, chopped bacon, spinach and onion.
Pour into a greased pie dish, where it makes its own base as it bakes.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden.

name: Jam Tarts
steps: Cook mixed berries with sugar and a squeeze of lemon for 6 minutes into a quick jam.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry in a muffin tray.
Fill each case with jam.
Bake at 180 degrees for 15 minutes until the pastry is golden.
Cool a little and serve.

name: Beef Rendang
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, potato and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, egg, capsicum, carrot and cucumber and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Mee Goreng
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg, cabbage and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce, honey and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Beef and Coconut Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook ginger, garlic and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, tomato and potato and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Ayam Goreng Style Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, egg, cucumber and flour and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Thai Green Fish Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Add white fish, green beans, capsicum and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, topped with basil, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Beef Massaman Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, potato, curry paste, peanut butter and cinnamon and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Tom Yum Style Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg, mushroom and tomato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Chilli Cabbage Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add bacon, egg and cabbage and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Japchae Style Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, spinach, carrot and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Bulgogi Style Beef
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, lettuce and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
