Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Spicy Pork and Tofu Stew
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, tofu, zucchini, mushroom and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add tofu and pork mince and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Dan Dan Style Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter, soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Sukiyaki Style Beef Pot
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a wide pot and bring to a simmer.
Add soy sauce and sugar.
Lay in beef strips, tofu, mushroom, cabbage and spring onion in sections.
Cook for 8 minutes, then add the noodles for 4 more minutes.
Serve with the beaten egg for dipping.

name: Teriyaki Style Chicken
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger, garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Katsu Curry
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Dip chicken breast in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Simmer onion with curry paste and coconut milk for 8 minutes into a sauce.
Serve chicken over rice with the sauce and shredded cabbage.

name: Beef Donburi Style Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Simmer beef strips and onion in soy sauce, sugar, ginger and a little water for 8 minutes.
Pour beaten eggs over the beef and cook gently until just set.
Serve over the rice.
Top with spring onion.

name: Tempura Style Prawns
steps: Whisk flour, beaten egg and cold water into a thin batter.
Dip the prawns in batter and fry for 3 minutes until crisp and pale gold.
Fry the potato into chunky chips.
Serve prawns with chips, lettuce and mayonnaise.
Add a wedge of lemon.

name: Reef and Beef
steps: Fry the beef strips until browned and set aside.
Melt butter and fry garlic and prawns until pink, then stir in cream for 2 minutes.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve beef over potato with the prawns and sauce on top.
Scatter parsley.

name: Pub Chicken and Gravy
steps: Dip chicken breast in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Whisk a spoon of the flour into the milk, heat with butter until thick, for a gravy.
Boil the potato, frozen peas and corn.
Serve the chicken with potato and veg and the gravy poured over.

name: Roast Lamb Loaf Dinner
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix lamb mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, onion, garlic and oregano and shape into a loaf.
Put the loaf in an oven dish with potato and pumpkin pieces and dots of butter.
Bake for 40 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, slice and serve.

name: Silverside Style Beef
steps: Put beef strips, potato, carrot, cabbage and onion in a big pot, cover with water and simmer for 40 minutes.
Take the beef and vegetables out and keep warm.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat with butter and some pot water until thick, then stir in parsley for a sauce.
Slice the beef.
Serve with the vegetables and parsley sauce.

name: Tuna Mornay with Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Whisk flour into the milk, heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Mix rice, tuna, corn, frozen peas and sauce in an oven dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and the rest of the cheese and bake for 18 minutes.

name: Mixed Seafood Chowder
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, prawns, salmon, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the bread, topped with parsley.

name: Chilli Prawn Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and spinach and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with butter, lemon and parsley and serve hot.

name: Roast Chicken with Gravy
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Put chicken thigh, potato, carrot, pumpkin and onion on a tray with dots of butter.
Bake for 40 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Pour the tray juices into a pot, whisk in flour and vegetable stock and heat until thick for a gravy.
Serve the chicken and veg with the gravy and parsley.

name: Pork Roast Style Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Shape the pork mince into a firm loaf shape and put on a tray with potato, sweet potato, onion and carrot and dots of butter.
Bake for 40 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Pour the tray juices into a pot, whisk in flour and vegetable stock and heat until thick for a gravy.
Slice the pork and serve with veg and gravy.

name: Lamb Patties with Peas
steps: Mix lamb mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg, garlic and oregano and shape into patties.
Fry the patties for 5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Boil the potato and frozen peas.
Serve patties with potato and peas.
Scatter parsley and add a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef and Kidney Bean Pie
steps: Fry beef strips and onion until browned, then stir in kidney beans, carrot and vegetable stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the beef mix and cover with pastry.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Creamy Chicken Pie
steps: Fry chicken thigh, celery and carrot until golden, then stir in the cream and frozen peas and simmer 6 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the chicken mix and cover with pastry.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 28 minutes until golden.

name: Salmon in Lemon Cream
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and spinach and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and lemon and serve hot.

name: Caramel Style Pork
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and cucumber and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in sugar, soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Thai Basil Beef
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and egg and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes, soy sauce and sugar and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with basil and serve over the rice.

name: Korean Chilli Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and spinach and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes, honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Japanese Style Beef Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, carrot, frozen peas, potato, curry paste and soy sauce and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Mongolian Style Beef
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic, onion and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce, sugar and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Szechuan Style Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and capsicum and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes, soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Braised Pork Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry pork mince with garlic and ginger until browned.
Add soy sauce, sugar and a little water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and halve, and wilt the spinach.
Serve pork over rice with egg, spinach and spring onion.

name: Ayam Kecap Style Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, tomato and cucumber and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce, honey and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Balinese Style Fish
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, capsicum, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Malaysian Style Chicken Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum, frozen peas, curry paste and peanut butter and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Aussie BBQ Plate
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Shape the beef mince into rissoles and put on a tray with chicken thigh pieces, capsicum and onion.
Bake for 25 minutes, adding the bacon for the last 10 minutes.
Boil the corn.
Serve everything with bread and salsa.

name: Breakfast Poutine
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees and bake potato wedges until crisp.
Whisk flour into the vegetable stock, heat with butter until thick, for a gravy.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Put wedges in bowls, top with cheese and hot gravy so the cheese melts.
Top with eggs and parsley and serve.

name: Huevos Divorciados
steps: Warm the crushed tomato with chopped onion in a pan into a red sauce.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan.
Put an egg on each tortilla, one side with salsa and the other with the red sauce.
Top with cheese and avocado and serve.

name: Migas Style Eggs
steps: Cut the tortillas into strips and fry until crisp.
Add onion and tomato and cook for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and pour over, stirring until just set.
Scatter cheese.
Serve with salsa and avocado.

name: Molletes
steps: Mash the kidney beans roughly and warm them through.
Toast the bread halves.
Spread beans thickly on the toast.
Top with cheese and grill or cover until it melts.
Add chopped tomato, onion and chilli flakes and serve.

name: Southwest Breakfast Skillet
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Fry potato, capsicum and onion in an oven safe pan until golden.
Stir in corn and black beans.
Make wells, crack the eggs in and scatter cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes and serve with salsa.

name: Egg in the Hole
steps: Cut a hole in the middle of each bread slice.
Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside.
Melt butter in the pan and put the bread in.
Crack an egg into each hole and cook for 3 minutes until set.
Top with cheese, bacon and tomato and serve.

name: Cheesy Grits Style Bowl
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and bacon and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with cheese and butter and serve over the couscous.

name: Pancake Tacos
steps: Whisk flour, beaten egg, milk and baking powder into a batter.
Fry small pancakes for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Fold each pancake like a taco.
Fill with greek yogurt and mixed berries.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Berry Bread Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Tear the bread into an oven dish with mixed berries.
Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon and honey and pour over.
Dot with butter and spoonfuls of ricotta.
Bake for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Savoury French Toast with Cheese
steps: Whisk the eggs in a wide dish.
Dip the bread in egg and top two slices with ham and cheese to make sandwiches.
Dip the sandwiches again lightly.
Fry in butter for 3 minutes each side until golden and melty.
Top with tomato and spring onion and serve.

name: Oat Waffle Style Cakes
steps: Whisk rolled oats, flour, beaten egg, milk and baking powder into a batter.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Fry thick cakes in butter for 3 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Serve with mixed berries and maple syrup.

name: Beetroot Berry Smoothie
steps: Put mixed berries, banana and greek yogurt in a blender.
Add honey and beetroot.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Chia and Oat Breakfast Pot
steps: Mix chia seeds, rolled oats, coconut milk, honey and cinnamon in a jar or bowl.
Rest in the fridge for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Top with mixed berries.
Serve cold.

name: Egg Bread Bowls
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cut the tops off the bread rolls and scoop out some middle to make bowls.
Butter the insides.
Fill with spinach, chopped tomato and cheese and crack an egg in.
Bake for 14 minutes until the egg is just set.

name: Idli Style Steamed Cakes
steps: Cook the rice until very soft and mash roughly.
Mix rice with flour, baking powder, greek yogurt and cumin into a thick batter.
Spoon into greased muffin cups and steam over a pan of water for 12 minutes.
Warm coconut milk with chilli flakes into a quick chutney.
Serve the cakes with the chutney.

name: Masala French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs with finely chopped onion, chilli flakes and cumin.
Dip the bread slices in the mix.
Fry in butter for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with chopped tomato.

name: Crispy Rice Crepes
steps: Cook the rice until soft and blend or mash it smooth with a little water.
Mix rice with flour, beaten egg, cumin, onion and chilli flakes into a thin batter.
Fry thin crepes for 2 minutes each side until crisp at the edges.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Churro Style Oats
steps: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cinnamon and sugar.
Top with mixed berries and cream and serve warm.

name: Chicken Cemita Style Sandwich
steps: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it.
Toast the bread rolls.
Fill with chicken, avocado, cheese, onion and tomato.
Add mayonnaise and chilli flakes.
Serve right away.

name: Pambazo Style Sandwich
steps: Boil the potato until soft and dice it.
Fry pork mince and potato until golden and stir in half the salsa.
Toast the bread rolls.
Fill with the pork mix, lettuce and cheese.
Top with sour cream and the rest of the salsa.

name: Tlacoyo Style Cakes
steps: Mix flour, corn and warm water into a dough and shape thick oval cakes.
Fry the cakes for 4 minutes each side until cooked through.
Mash the black beans and warm them through.
Top cakes with beans, cheese, lettuce and salsa.
Add sour cream and serve.

name: Sope Style Flatbreads
steps: Mix flour, corn and warm water into a dough, shape thick flatbreads and fry for 4 minutes each side.
Fry the chicken breast until cooked, then shred it.
Mash the kidney beans and spread on the flatbreads.
Top with chicken, lettuce and cheese.
Add salsa and sour cream and serve.

name: Esquites Style Corn Cups
steps: Boil the potato until soft and dice it, and boil the corn for 3 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix corn and potato with mayonnaise and chilli flakes.
Spoon into cups and top with egg and feta.
Add a squeeze of lime and serve.

name: Aztec Style Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add black beans, corn and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cheese and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the tortilla, topped with avocado.

name: Calabacitas
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add zucchini, corn and tomato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with cheese and serve over the rice.

name: Rajas con Crema Style
steps: Fry capsicum strips and onion until soft and sweet.
Add corn and cream and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in cheese until it melts.
Warm the tortillas.
Serve the rajas with the tortillas.

name: Papas con Chorizo Style
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, egg, potato and tortilla and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Frijoles Style Bean Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry onion and garlic with cumin, add kidney beans and a splash of water and mash roughly as they warm.
Warm the tortillas.
Serve beans over rice with cheese.
Add salsa and eat with tortilla pieces.

name: Gorditas
steps: Mix flour, corn and warm water into a dough and shape thick round cakes.
Fry the cakes for 4 minutes each side until puffed and cooked.
Fry beef mince until browned.
Split the cakes part way and fill with beef, lettuce and cheese.
Top with salsa and sour cream.

name: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
steps: Cook onion and garlic in the butter in a pot for 4 minutes.
Add crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in cream and basil.
Make a grilled cheese sandwich with the bread and cheese in a hot pan.
Serve the soup with the sandwich for dipping.

name: Chicken Philly Sandwich
steps: Fry chicken breast strips, capsicum and onion in butter until golden.
Toast the bread rolls and spread with mayonnaise.
Fill with the chicken mix.
Top with cheese and let it melt for 1 minute.
Serve hot.

name: Reuben Style Sandwich
steps: Fry the beef strips until browned.
Mix cabbage with mayonnaise and salsa into a slaw.
Butter the bread and toast in a pan.
Fill with beef, slaw and cheese.
Grill until the cheese melts and serve.

name: Monte Cristo Sandwich
steps: Make ham and cheese sandwiches with the bread.
Whisk egg and milk in a wide dish and dip the sandwiches.
Fry in butter for 3 minutes each side until golden and melty.
Dust with sugar.
Serve warm.

name: Curried Chicken Salad
steps: Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop cucumber and lettuce.
Put bread and greek yogurt in a big bowl.
Add mayonnaise, curry paste and lemon and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Corn Dog Style Bites
steps: Shape the pork mince into small sausages and fry until cooked through.
Mix flour, corn, beaten egg and milk into a thick batter.
Dip each sausage in batter.
Fry for 3 minutes, turning, until golden all over.
Serve with honey and salsa for dipping.

name: BBQ Chicken and Slaw Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Rub chicken thigh with smoked paprika and fry until cooked through, then slice.
Mix cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise into a slaw, and boil the corn.
Serve rice topped with chicken, slaw and corn.
Drizzle with honey.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Dip cauliflower pieces in flour, then beaten egg, and bake for 18 minutes until crisp.
Melt butter with chilli flakes and garlic and toss the cauliflower through it.
Serve with greek yogurt and celery sticks.

name: Loaded Fries
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees and bake potato fries until crisp.
Fry beef mince and bacon until browned.
Put fries on a tray and top with beef, bacon and cheese.
Bake for 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream, salsa and spring onion.

name: Mac and Cheese Bites
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says and drain.
Whisk a spoon of the flour into the milk, heat until thick, then stir in cheese and the pasta.
Chill the mix until firm, then shape into balls.
Dip balls in the rest of the flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.

name: Chicken Skewers with Pita and Salad
steps: Marinate chicken breast pieces in lemon, oregano, garlic and olive oil for 10 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and fry or grill for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the pita bread.
Chop cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve skewers with pita, salad and greek yogurt.

name: Eggs in Spiced Tomato
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry onion and capsicum in olive oil, add crushed tomato and cumin and simmer for 6 minutes.
Tip into an oven dish and make wells.
Crack the eggs in and scatter feta.
Bake for 10 minutes and serve with warm pita bread.

name: Italian Sub Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Fill with salami, ham, lettuce, tomato and mozzarella.
Add mayonnaise and pesto and fold or roll up.
Serve right away.

name: Tomato Ricotta Crostini
steps: Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic.
Spread ricotta thickly on each slice.
Top with cherry tomato halves.
Drizzle with olive oil and scatter basil.
Serve right away.

name: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry chicken thigh and onion until golden, then shred the chicken.
Layer tortillas, chicken, black beans, corn and salsa in an oven dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with sour cream.

name: Tamale Style Beef Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry beef mince with taco seasoning until browned and stir in black beans and corn.
Layer torn tortilla and beef mix in an oven dish.
Pour tomato passata over.
Top with cheese and bake for 18 minutes.
Serve with sour cream.

name: Pork Tinga Tacos
steps: Fry pork mince, onion and garlic until browned.
Add crushed tomato and chilli flakes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with pork, cabbage and avocado.
Top with sour cream and serve.

name: Fish a la Mexicana
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add white fish, zucchini, capsicum and corn and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve over the rice.

name: Chicken Rojas
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and capsicum and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes and tomato passata and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with sour cream and serve over the rice.

name: Beef Colorado
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, cumin and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Pork Pibil Style Tacos
steps: Fry pork mince with smoked paprika, garlic and onion until browned and a little crisp.
Add the juice of the limes and stir through.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with pork and cabbage.
Top with sour cream and serve.

name: Birria Style Beef Tacos
steps: Simmer beef strips in crushed tomato, onion, garlic, cumin, chilli flakes and vegetable stock for 35 minutes until tender.
Shred the beef and keep the sauce for dipping.
Fill warm tortillas with beef and cheese and fry until crisp.
Serve with the sauce for dipping and a wedge of lime.

name: Pozole Verde Style Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, spinach, corn, capsicum, cabbage and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Prawn Zarandeado Style
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, cucumber and tomato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in mayonnaise and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Lamb Salsa Verde
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add lamb mince, spinach and capsicum and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with sour cream and lime and serve over the rice.

name: Veggie Tamale Style Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry capsicum and zucchini for 5 minutes and stir in black beans.
Mix flour, corn and milk into a thick batter.
Put the bean mix in an oven dish and spread the batter over.
Top with salsa and cheese and bake for 22 minutes.

name: Smoky Chicken and Beans
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, kidney beans and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Brisket Style Beef
steps: Put beef strips, tomato passata, honey, smoked paprika, garlic and onion in a big pot with 300 ml water.
Cover and simmer very gently for 40 minutes until tender.
Boil the potato and corn and mash the potato with butter.
Serve beef and sauce over mash with corn.

name: Sticky Pork Bites
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Herb Chicken Tray with Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, carrot, green beans and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 37 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: BBQ Glazed Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, onion and smoked paprika and shape into a loaf.
Mix tomato passata and honey and spread over the loaf.
Bake for 40 minutes with potato wedges, boiling the corn near the end.
Rest 5 minutes, slice and serve.

name: Chicken Pot Roast with Veg
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, carrot, green beans and potato and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 40 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot, topped with parsley.

name: Beef Stew with Dumplings
steps: Melt half the butter in a big pot and fry beef strips, celery, carrot and onion for 6 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomato and vegetable stock and add frozen peas and simmer for 30 minutes.
Rub the rest of the butter into the flour, add water into a soft dough and drop spoonfuls on top of the stew.
Cover and cook 12 more minutes until the dumplings puff up.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

name: Smothered Pork Patties
steps: Shape the pork mince into patties and fry until browned, then set aside.
Fry onion and garlic in butter until soft and sweet.
Whisk flour into the vegetable stock and milk, add to the pan and heat until thick.
Put the patties back and simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with boiled potato and green beans.

name: Smoky Chicken Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, bacon, egg, frozen peas and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Beef and Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, egg, frozen peas and cabbage and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Prawn Fried Rice with Ginger and Lime
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg, capsicum and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add egg, capsicum, carrot, frozen peas and corn and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Chicken Lo Mein
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, mushroom, spinach and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Beef Lo Mein with Mushroom
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, mushroom and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Pork Chow Fun Style
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, capsicum and cabbage and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Singapore Style Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, chicken breast, egg and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in curry paste and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Hokkien Style Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, prawns, cabbage and carrot and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Char Kway Teow Style
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.

name: Prawn Laksa
steps: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Stir in curry paste and garlic and add carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and prawns and cook for 4 minutes until the prawns are pink.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lime.

name: Curry Noodle Soup with Chicken
steps: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Stir in curry paste and add chicken breast and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
Take the chicken out, shred it and put it back.
Add the noodles and spinach and cook 4 more minutes.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lime.

name: Wonton Style Soup
steps: Mix flour with warm water into a dough, rest 15 minutes and roll out small squares.
Fill each square with a little pork mince mixed with ginger and garlic, fold and pinch.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Drop the wontons in with spinach and cook for 5 minutes until they float.
Serve with spring onion and soy sauce.

name: Hot Pot Style Dinner
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a wide pot and bring to a simmer with soy sauce and chilli flakes.
Lay in beef strips, prawns, tofu, mushroom and cabbage in sections.
Cook for 6 minutes, then add the noodles for 4 more minutes.
Top with spring onion and serve straight from the pot.

name: Beef Bibimbap Style Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add beef strips, egg, carrot, cucumber and mushroom and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Korean BBQ Chicken
steps: Fry chicken thigh pieces until browned, then add soy sauce, honey, garlic and ginger and cook until sticky.
Cook the noodles as the pack says and drain.
Stir the spinach through the hot noodles until it wilts.
Serve chicken over the noodles.
Top with spring onion.

name: Hamburg Steak
steps: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and onion and shape into thick steaks.
Fry for 6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Add soy sauce and honey to the pan and cook until sticky and glazed.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve steaks over rice and shredded cabbage with spring onion.

name: Tonkatsu Style Pork
steps: Shape the pork mince into flat cutlets.
Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve pork sliced over cabbage and rice with mayonnaise and a wedge of lemon.

name: Oyakodon
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Simmer chicken thigh and onion in soy sauce, sugar and a little water for 10 minutes.
Add spinach until it wilts.
Pour beaten eggs over and cook gently until just set.
Serve over rice with spring onion.

name: Chicken Nanban Style
steps: Dip chicken thigh pieces in flour, then beaten egg, and fry until crisp and golden.
Mix mayonnaise with a squeeze of lemon and chopped cucumber into a tartare style sauce.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve chicken over rice and cabbage with the sauce and a splash of soy sauce.

name: Beef Negimaki Style
steps: Wrap beef strips around bundles of spring onion.
Fry in olive oil for 6 minutes, turning, until browned.
Add soy sauce, honey and ginger and cook until sticky.
Cook the rice as the pack says and wilt the spinach.
Serve the beef rolls over rice and spinach.

name: Glazed Salmon with Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and green beans and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the rice.

name: Dengaku Style Fish
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add white fish and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Salmon Rice Soup
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring to a simmer.
Add rice and ginger and cook for 12 minutes.
Add salmon pieces and spinach and cook 4 more minutes.
Stir in soy sauce.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Curry Rice with Egg
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, egg, carrot, frozen peas, potato and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Dip chicken breast in flour and fry in butter for 5 minutes each side until golden.
Cook the pasta as the pack says, adding green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Add garlic and a squeeze of lemon to the chicken pan and swirl for 1 minute.
Scatter parsley over the chicken.
Serve the chicken over the pasta and beans.

name: Masala Dosa Style Crepes
steps: Cook the rice until soft and blend or mash it smooth with the flour and water into a thin batter.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with fried onion, cumin, garam masala and chilli flakes.
Fry thin crepes for 2 minutes each side until crisp at the edges.
Fill crepes with the potato mix and fold.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Uttapam Style Pancakes
steps: Cook the rice until soft and mash it smooth with the flour, beaten egg and water into a thick batter.
Fry thick pancakes for 3 minutes until bubbles show.
Scatter tomato, onion, capsicum and chilli flakes on top.
Flip and fry 2 more minutes.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Pongal
steps: Put rice, lentils, ginger and cumin in a pot with 600 ml water.
Simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and porridge like.
Stir in frozen peas and butter for the last 3 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Dhokla Style Steamed Cakes
steps: Whisk flour, greek yogurt, beaten egg, baking powder and coconut milk into a batter.
Pour into greased muffin cups.
Steam over a pan of water for 12 minutes until spongy.
Fry cumin and chilli flakes in a dry pan and scatter over.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Thepla Style Flatbreads
steps: Chop the spinach finely and mix into the flour with cumin and garam masala.
Add greek yogurt and a little water into a soft dough.
Roll out thin flatbreads.
Fry in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side, brushing with butter.
Serve warm.

name: Vada Style Lentil Fritters
steps: Cook the lentils until very soft and drain well.
Mash lentils with onion, ginger, cumin, chilli flakes and flour.
Shape into small flat fritters.
Fry in olive oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve with greek yogurt.

name: Tiganites Greek Pancakes
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add egg and flour and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey, cinnamon and milk and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with greek yogurt and lemon and serve hot.

name: Loukoumades Honey Puffs
steps: Whisk flour, baking powder, milk and beaten egg into a thick batter.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Fry spoonfuls for 3 minutes, turning, until puffed and golden.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Serve with sliced banana.

name: Sweet Honey and Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread ricotta thickly on each slice.
Top with sliced banana.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Serve right away.

name: Banana Frittelle
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with flour, beaten egg, greek yogurt and sugar into a batter.
Fry spoonfuls in butter for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve warm.

name: Panna Cotta Style Pots
steps: Warm cream, milk, sugar and honey in a pot until the sugar melts, but do not boil.
Take off the heat and whisk in the greek yogurt.
Pour into two glasses or pots.
Chill for at least 2 hours until just set.
Top with mixed berries and serve.

name: Tramezzino Style Sandwiches
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and slice.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise.
Spread tuna on the bread.
Top with egg slices, lettuce and tomato.
Cut into triangles and serve.

name: Breakfast Piadina
steps: Mix flour with olive oil and warm water into a dough and roll out two flatbreads.
Fry the flatbreads in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side.
Scramble the eggs with spinach.
Fill the flatbreads with egg, cheese and tomato.
Fold and serve.

name: Veggie Egg Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Whisk eggs and milk.
Stir in chopped capsicum, corn, spring onion and cheese.
Pour into a greased muffin tray.
Bake for 14 minutes until just set.

name: Avocado Egg Boats
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Halve the avocado and take out a little flesh to make room.
Crack an egg into each half.
Top with chopped bacon and bake for 14 minutes until the egg is just set.
Scatter spring onion and chilli flakes and serve with the bread, toasted.

name: Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread greek yogurt thickly on a lined tray.
Drizzle with maple syrup.
Scatter mixed berries, chia seeds and granola.
Freeze for at least 2 hours.
Break into pieces and serve.

name: Quick Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs softly with the spinach.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with egg and cheese.
Add salsa, roll up and serve.

name: Peanut Banana Oats Jar
steps: Layer rolled oats, peanut butter and sliced banana in a jar or bowl.
Pour the milk over.
Drizzle with maple syrup.
Rest for 10 minutes, or overnight in the fridge, and serve.

name: Farinata Style Flatbread
steps: Mash the chickpeas with flour, olive oil and warm water into a thick batter and stir in oregano.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Pour into a hot oiled oven tray and top with sliced onion and tomato.
Bake at 200 degrees for 18 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Cut into wedges and serve.

name: Socca with Roast Veg
steps: Mash the chickpeas with flour, olive oil and warm water into a thick batter.
Pour into a hot oiled oven tray.
Top with zucchini, capsicum and red onion.
Bake at 200 degrees for 20 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Scatter feta and serve.

name: Piadina with Ham and Cheese
steps: Mix flour with olive oil and warm water into a dough and roll out two flatbreads.
Fry the flatbreads in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side.
Fill with ham, mozzarella, tomato and spinach.
Fold and put back in the pan for 2 minutes until the mozzarella melts.
Serve warm.

name: Taralli Style Crackers with Dip
steps: Mix flour, olive oil, beaten egg and warm water into a dough and shape into small rings.
Bake at 180 degrees for 18 minutes until crisp.
Mix greek yogurt with grated cucumber and a squeeze of lemon into a dip.
Crumble feta over the dip.
Serve the crackers with the dip.

name: Pesto Pancake Bites
steps: Whisk flour, beaten egg and milk into a thin batter.
Fry thin pancakes for 1 minute each side.
Cut the pancakes into diamonds and warm them in a pan with a splash of water.
Toss with pesto and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Serve with parmesan.

name: Lagane Style Pasta and Chickpeas
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the pasta, topped with parsley.

name: Orecchiette Style Broccoli Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add broccoli and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan and lemon and serve hot.

name: Culurgiones Style Dumplings
steps: Boil the potato until soft and mash with cheese and beaten egg.
Mix flour with warm water into a dough and roll out circles.
Fill each circle, fold and pinch the edges in a rope pattern if you can.
Boil the dumplings for 4 minutes until they float.
Serve with warm tomato passata and melted butter with garlic.

name: Seadas Style Cheese Pastries
steps: Mix flour with melted butter, beaten egg and warm water into a dough and roll out circles.
Fill with cheese, fold and pinch the edges.
Fry for 3 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Drizzle with honey and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Dakos Salad
steps: Chop tomato, olives and cucumber.
Put bread and feta in a big bowl.
Add oregano and olive oil and toss well.
Serve fresh.

name: Horta Greens with Egg
steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan with garlic until just soft.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, peel and halve.
Put the warm spinach on plates.
Top with eggs and feta.
Dress with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon and serve with the bread.

name: Gigantes Style Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomato and black beans.
Tip into an oven dish and bake for 22 minutes.
Top with parsley and serve with the bread.

name: Kolokithokeftedes
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, zucchini and flour and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with feta, greek yogurt and parsley and serve hot.

name: Tomatokeftedes
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, tomato and flour and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in oregano and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with feta and greek yogurt and serve hot.

name: Boureki Style Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees and grease a dish with butter.
Layer sliced potato and zucchini in the dish.
Whisk eggs, milk and flour and pour over.
Top with cheese.
Bake for 32 minutes until set and golden.

name: Aloo Tikki
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, frozen peas, potato and flour and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and garam masala and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with greek yogurt and serve hot.

name: Halloumi Tikka Wrap
steps: Rub the halloumi with curry paste and fry for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Mix greek yogurt with grated cucumber.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with halloumi, spinach, tomato and the yogurt mix.
Roll up and serve.

name: Chole with Fried Bread
steps: Fry onion, tomato and garam masala for 5 minutes, then add chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix flour, baking powder and greek yogurt into a dough and roll out small rounds.
Fry the rounds for 2 minutes each side until puffed and golden.
Serve the chickpeas with the fried rounds.

name: Coconut Lentil Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, spinach and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Egg Curry Bowl
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add egg, tomato, frozen peas, spinach and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Vegetable Pilau
steps: Fry onion, cauliflower and carrot in olive oil with garam masala for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and 500 ml water, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas for the last 4 minutes.
Rest with the lid on for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Quick Tuna Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Put rice in bowls and top with tuna, cucumber and carrot.
Scatter spring onion and chilli flakes.
Serve warm.

name: Quick Chicken Noodle Pot
steps: Pour the vegetable stock into a deep pan and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken breast strips and ginger and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and corn and cook 4 more minutes.
Stir in soy sauce.
Top with spring onion and serve.

name: Quick Bean and Cheese Toast
steps: Warm the black beans and corn in a small pan.
Toast the bread.
Top toast with beans and corn.
Add cheese and salsa.
Serve right away.

name: Quick Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, ham and frozen peas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Quick Egg and Mozzarella Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Top with mozzarella and tomato and grill or warm until the mozzarella softens.
Fry the eggs in olive oil.
Put an egg on each toast and serve.

name: Hummus Style Plate
steps: Blend chickpeas with lemon, garlic and olive oil until smooth, adding cold water if you need it.
Spoon onto a plate and dust with smoked paprika.
Warm the pita bread.
Serve with cucumber and tomato for scooping.

name: Chicken Dopiaza
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, tomato, capsicum and garam masala and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Beef Madras
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, capsicum, potato, garam masala and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Lamb Pasanda
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook garlic, ginger and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Prawn Patia
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, tomato and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in sugar and garam masala and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Fish Dopiaza
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add white fish and tomato and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and garam masala and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the rice.

name: Pork Methi Style
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Tofu Jalfrezi
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, capsicum and spinach and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Vegetable Kolhapuri Style
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, capsicum, potato, garam masala and chilli flakes and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Spinach Dal
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, spinach, tomato and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Rajma
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add kidney beans, capsicum, spinach and garam masala and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Lobia Style Black Beans
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add black beans, tomato, spinach, cumin and garam masala and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken Giouvetsi Style
steps: Cook the pasta in the same pot after the chicken, as below.
Fry chicken thigh and onion in olive oil until golden.
Add crushed tomato, garlic, cinnamon and 500 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and cook 10 more minutes until the pasta is soft and the sauce is thick.
Serve with parmesan.

name: Beef Kokkinisto
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips and cinnamon and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in feta and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta.

name: Lamb Frikasee Style
steps: Fry lamb mince and onion in olive oil until browned.
Add 500 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes with the spinach.
Whisk the eggs with a squeeze of lemon and a ladle of the hot liquid.
Stir the egg mix back in gently for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens a little, but do not boil.
Serve over the rice with spring onion.

name: Pork Lemonato
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, spinach, potato and oregano and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve hot, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Prawn Giouvetsi
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Fry onion and garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomato and oregano and simmer for 6 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and 400 ml water and tip into an oven dish.
Top with prawns and feta.
Bake for 18 minutes until the pasta is soft and the prawns are pink.

name: Chicken Kapama
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum and cinnamon and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in feta and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken alla Romana
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, capsicum and potato and cook for 23 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in oregano and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Beef Braciole Style
steps: Mix breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic and parsley.
Lay the mix on the beef strips, roll up and tie or pin with toothpicks.
Fry the rolls in olive oil until browned all over.
Add crushed tomato and simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Cook the pasta as the pack says and serve the rolls and sauce over it.

name: Pork Scaloppine
steps: Shape the pork mince into thin patties and dip in flour.
Fry in butter for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Cook the pasta as the pack says, adding green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Add garlic and a squeeze of lemon to the pork pan and swirl for 1 minute.
Scatter parsley and serve the pork over the pasta and beans.

name: Tuna Siciliana
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tuna, olives and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in oregano and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the couscous.

name: Lamb Scottadito Style
steps: Mix lamb mince with breadcrumbs, garlic and oregano and shape into small thick patties.
Fry for 5 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve patties with potato and beans and a squeeze of lemon, with olive oil drizzled over.

name: Chicken Diavola
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, spinach and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh, chilli flakes and honey to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan, parsley and lemon and serve hot.

name: Pasta al Limone
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with parmesan, butter and lemon and serve hot.

name: Arrabbiata Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato and warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with mozzarella and basil and serve hot.

name: Quick Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says and drain, keeping a little of the water.
Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, a squeeze of lime and chilli flakes with the hot noodle water into a sauce.
Toss the noodles through the sauce.
Top with cucumber, carrot and spring onion and serve.

name: Quick Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Fry the chicken breast strips until cooked through and slice.
Put tortillas in a dry pan one at a time.
Fill with chicken, cheese, corn and spinach.
Fold and fry for 2 minutes each side until crisp and melted.
Serve with salsa.

name: Quick Tuna Tacos
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise, chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Warm the corn in a small pan.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with tuna, cabbage and corn.
Serve right away.

name: Quick Egg and Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg and spinach and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with avocado and serve over the rice.

name: Quick Bean and Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the black beans and corn in a pot.
Put rice in bowls and top with beans and corn.
Add cheese, salsa and avocado.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and serve.

name: Salmon Poke Style Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says and let it cool a little.
Fry the salmon until just cooked and flake it, or serve it in pieces.
Mix mayonnaise with soy sauce and a squeeze of lime.
Put rice in bowls and top with salmon, cucumber and avocado.
Drizzle the sauce and scatter spring onion.

name: Quick Teriyaki Chicken Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and broccoli and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Quick Prawn Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, capsicum and cucumber and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Quick Tofu Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, broccoli and carrot and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Quick Pork Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, cabbage and carrot and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Quick Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add beef mince and capsicum and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in taco seasoning and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with cheese and lime and serve over the rice.

name: Lamb and Zucchini Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry lamb mince and onion in olive oil with cinnamon until browned and stir in crushed tomato.
Whisk ricotta with beaten egg into a sauce.
Layer zucchini slices and lamb mix in an oven dish.
Top with the ricotta sauce and cheese and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Lamb Biryani
steps: Fry lamb mince and onion in olive oil with garam masala and garlic until browned.
Stir in the rice and 700 ml water, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas for the last 5 minutes.
Rest with the lid on for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Fish Pilau
steps: Fry onion and ginger in butter with cumin and garam masala for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and 700 ml water, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Lay the white fish pieces on top with frozen peas and spinach and cook 6 more minutes until the fish is just done.
Rest with the lid on for 5 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Seafood Orzo Style
steps: Fry onion and garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomato and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and 600 ml water and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add prawns and white fish pieces and cook 5 more minutes until just done.
Top with feta and a squeeze of lemon and serve.

name: Kheema Pav Style
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef mince, tomato, frozen peas and bread and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and lemon and serve hot.

name: Brekkie Bowl
steps: Soak the rolled oats and chia seeds in the milk for 10 minutes.
Spoon into bowls with greek yogurt.
Top with mixed berries.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve.

name: Eggs and Soldiers
steps: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes so the yolks stay runny.
Toast the bread and spread with butter.
Cut the toast into fingers.
Put the eggs in cups, take the tops off and serve with the toast fingers for dipping.

name: Brekkie Jaffle
steps: Scramble the eggs softly with the spinach.
Put cheese, egg and ham between the bread slices.
Toast in a hot dry pan, pressing down, for 3 minutes each side until golden and melted.
Cut in half and serve.

name: Potato Scallops
steps: Slice the potato into thick rounds and boil for 5 minutes, then drain.
Whisk flour, beaten egg, baking powder and a little water into a batter.
Dip the potato slices in batter.
Fry in butter for 3 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Serve with sour cream.

name: Pavlova Breakfast Bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 120 degrees.
Whisk the egg whites with sugar until stiff and glossy, with a squeeze of lemon.
Spoon small mounds on a lined tray and bake for 30 minutes until crisp.
Cool, then break into bowls.
Top with cream, mixed berries and sliced banana.

name: Breakfast Sanga
steps: Shape the pork mince into two flat patties and fry for 4 minutes each side.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast the bread.
Build sangas with pork, egg, cheese and tomato.
Serve hot.

name: Peanut Oat Pancakes
steps: Blitz the rolled oats into a rough flour and mix with flour and baking powder.
Whisk in beaten egg, milk and peanut butter into a batter.
Fry small pancakes in butter for 2 minutes each side.
Serve with sliced banana.

name: Spoonbread
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Whisk milk, eggs, flour and baking powder into a batter.
Stir in corn, cheese and melted butter.
Pour into a greased oven dish.
Bake for 28 minutes until puffed and golden and spoon out to serve.

name: Hush Puppies with Eggs
steps: Mix corn, flour, one beaten egg, baking powder, onion and milk into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in butter for 3 minutes, turning, until crisp.
Fry the bacon and the other eggs.
Serve the hush puppies with bacon and eggs.

name: Western Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, spring onion, capsicum, mushroom and ham for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with butter and serve.

name: Hoppin John Breakfast
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry bacon, capsicum and onion with smoked paprika for 5 minutes.
Stir in black beans and the rice and warm through.
Fry the eggs and put one on each plate.
Serve hot.

name: Prawn Grits Style Bowl
steps: Simmer the corn in the milk for 10 minutes, then mash roughly into a thick porridge.
Stir in cheese and butter.
Fry prawns with garlic and chilli flakes for 3 minutes until pink.
Spoon the corn porridge into bowls and top with prawns.
Scatter spring onion and serve.

name: Sweet Potato Pie Oats
steps: Boil the sweet potato until soft and mash.
Cook the rolled oats in the milk as the pack says.
Stir the sweet potato mash through the porridge with cinnamon and sugar.
Top with butter and maple syrup and serve.

name: Banana Pudding Style Pots
steps: Whisk flour and sugar into the milk in a pot and heat, stirring, until thick like custard.
Cool the custard a little and stir in the cream.
Tear the bread into two pots and layer with banana slices and custard.
Dust with cinnamon.
Chill for 30 minutes if you can and serve.

name: Veggie Snack Rolls
steps: Whisk flour, beaten egg and water into a thin batter and fry thin crepes.
Stir fry cabbage, carrot and corn in olive oil with soy sauce for 4 minutes.
Fill each crepe with the veg and roll up tightly.
Fry the rolls for 2 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve hot.

name: Potato Cakes
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, potato and flour and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with cheese and butter and serve hot.

name: Zucchini and Bacon Slice
steps: Heat the oven to 170 degrees.
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the water.
Whisk eggs and flour, then stir in zucchini, cheese, bacon, onion and olive oil.
Pour into a lined tin.
Bake for 28 minutes until set and golden, then slice.

name: Curried Egg Sandwiches
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and mash.
Mix eggs with curry paste and mayonnaise.
Spread on the bread.
Top with lettuce and cucumber.
Cut into triangles and serve.

name: Aussie Burger with Beetroot
steps: Shape the beef mince into patties and fry for 4 minutes each side.
Fry the eggs and warm the bread rolls.
Build burgers with beef, cheese, beetroot, egg, lettuce, tomato and onion.
Serve hot.

name: Snack Pack Style Fries
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees and bake potato fries until crisp.
Fry chicken thigh pieces until cooked through and slice.
Mix greek yogurt with garlic and mayonnaise into a sauce.
Put fries in a tray and top with chicken and cheese.
Warm until the cheese melts, then add sauce and salsa and serve.

name: Succotash
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add kidney beans, corn, capsicum and tomato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with butter and parsley and serve hot.

name: Brunswick Stew
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, kidney beans, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Burgoo Style Stew
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, chicken thigh, carrot, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Frogmore Style Stew
steps: Melt the butter in a big pot and add smoked paprika and capsicum.
Add potato pieces and 500 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add corn and cook 5 more minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Serve in bowls with a wedge of lemon.

name: Lowcountry Style Rice
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion, celery and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, bacon and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Prawn Etouffee Style
steps: Melt butter and whisk in flour, cooking for 2 minutes until golden.
Add capsicum, onion and celery and cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock with smoked paprika and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Serve over the rice, cooked as the pack says.

name: Salisbury Style Patties
steps: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and onion and shape into patties.
Fry patties for 5 minutes each side, then set aside.
Fry mushroom in the pan, whisk flour into the vegetable stock and milk and add, heating until thick.
Put patties back in the sauce for 3 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Tater Tot Style Bites
steps: Grate the potato, squeeze dry and mix with flour, beaten egg, cheese and smoked paprika.
Shape into small cylinders on a lined tray.
Bake at 200 degrees for 22 minutes until crisp and golden.
Serve with sour cream.

name: Hobo Foil Packets
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Shape the beef mince into patties.
Put a patty on foil with sliced potato, carrot, onion and capsicum and a knob of butter.
Fold the foil into parcels.
Bake for 28 minutes, open, top with cheese and serve.

name: Campfire Chilli
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, kidney beans, capsicum and cumin and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in cheese and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the bread.

name: Berry Dump Cake
steps: Put the mixed berries in an oven dish.
Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon and rub in the butter into crumbs.
Whisk the egg and milk and stir into the crumbs roughly.
Drop spoonfuls of the mix over the berries.
Bake at 180 degrees for 26 minutes until golden.

name: Berry Brown Betty
steps: Tear the bread into crumbs and mix with melted butter, sugar and cinnamon.
Layer crumbs and mixed berries in an oven dish, ending with crumbs.
Bake at 180 degrees for 22 minutes until crisp on top.
Serve warm with cream.

name: Fish Chowder
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, corn and potato and stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Mississippi Style Beef
steps: Melt the butter in a big pot and fry beef strips, onion, garlic and capsicum for 6 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, cover and simmer very gently for 35 minutes until tender.
Boil the potato and carrot until soft.
Serve the beef and its juices over the potato and carrot.

name: Alabama Style Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, corn and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh, mayonnaise and smoked paprika to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Texas Style Chilli
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, kidney beans, cumin, chilli flakes and smoked paprika and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the bread.

name: Country Fried Chicken
steps: Dip chicken thigh pieces in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in butter for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Whisk a spoon of the flour into the milk in the pan and heat until thick into a gravy.
Boil the corn and green beans.
Serve chicken with gravy, corn and beans.

name: Chicken Stew with Dumplings
steps: Melt half the butter in a big pot and fry chicken thigh, potato, carrot and onion for 6 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomato and vegetable stock and add frozen peas and corn and simmer for 30 minutes.
Rub the rest of the butter into the flour, add water into a soft dough and drop spoonfuls on top of the stew.
Cover and cook 12 more minutes until the dumplings puff up.
Serve hot.

name: Sunday Roast Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Put chicken thigh, potato, carrot and onion on a tray with lemon halves, oregano and the butter in knobs and roast for 40 minutes, adding green beans for the last 10.
Pour the tray juices into a pan with the vegetable stock and simmer for 3 minutes into a light gravy.
Serve the chicken and veg with the gravy.

name: Roast Beef Dinner
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Put potato, pumpkin, carrot and onion on a tray with the butter in knobs and roast for 40 minutes.
Fry the beef strips hot and fast for 5 minutes and rest them, adding green beans to the tray for the last 10 minutes of roasting.
Whisk flour into the pan juices with vegetable stock into a gravy.
Serve beef and roast veg with gravy.

name: Roast Pork Style Dinner
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Shape the pork mince with oregano into a loaf and put on a tray with potato, pumpkin and onion and the butter in knobs.
Roast for 35 minutes, adding frozen peas for the last 5.
Rest the loaf, then whisk flour into the tray juices with vegetable stock into a gravy.
Slice the loaf and serve with veg and gravy.

name: Sausages and Mash, Pub Style
steps: Shape the pork mince into sausages and fry for 10 minutes until browned all over.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with butter and milk.
Fry onion until soft and sweet, whisk flour into the vegetable stock and add, heating until thick into an onion gravy.
Boil the frozen peas.
Serve sausages on mash with gravy and peas.

name: Lamb Shepherds Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry lamb mince, onion and carrot in olive oil until browned, stir in crushed tomato and frozen peas and simmer for 8 minutes.
Boil the sweet potato until soft and mash it.
Put the lamb mix in an oven dish and top with mash and cheese.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden.

name: Seafood Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with a splash of the milk, half the butter and the beaten egg.
Melt the rest of the butter, whisk in flour and the rest of the milk and heat until thick.
Stir white fish, prawns, corn and celery into the sauce and tip into an oven dish.
Top with mash and bake for 22 minutes.

name: Chicken and Corn Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry chicken thigh, celery, onion and garlic until golden.
Stir in a spoon of the flour, then the cream and corn, and simmer until thick.
Rub butter into the rest of the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Put the chicken mix in a pie dish, cover with pastry and bake for 25 minutes.

name: Steak Diane Style
steps: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, mushroom, green beans and potato and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and parsley and serve hot.

name: Pepper Steak
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and capsicum and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce, sugar and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken Dinner
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, mushroom and spinach and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and parmesan and serve over the pasta.

name: Vegetable Pot Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry onion, potato and carrot in a knob of the butter for 6 minutes.
Stir in a spoon of the flour, then the milk, frozen peas and corn, and simmer until thick.
Rub the rest of the butter into the rest of the flour, add cold water and roll out pastry.
Put the veg mix in a pie dish, top with cheese, cover with pastry and bake for 25 minutes.

name: Broccoli Mac Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Cook the pasta as the pack says, adding broccoli for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour and milk and heat until thick, then stir in most of the cheese.
Mix pasta and broccoli through the sauce and tip into an oven dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese and the breadcrumbs and bake for 18 minutes.

name: Lasagna Soup
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince and stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in ricotta and mozzarella and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta, topped with basil.

name: Stuffed Capsicums with Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry chicken breast pieces with onion and garlic in olive oil until golden.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, rest 5 minutes and fluff, then mix with the chicken and crushed tomato.
Halve the capsicums and fill with the mix.
Top with cheese and bake for 22 minutes.

name: Zucchini Parmigiana Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Dip zucchini slices in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in olive oil for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Layer zucchini, crushed tomato, mozzarella and basil in an oven dish.
Top with parmesan and bake for 20 minutes.

name: Ratatouille and Bean Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Fry zucchini, capsicum, onion and garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomato, oregano and kidney beans.
Tip into an oven dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve over couscous, made as the pack says.

name: Provencal Style Chicken
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, olives, capsicum and spinach and cook for 23 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in oregano and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: One Pot Spanish Chicken
steps: Fry chicken thigh pieces in olive oil until golden and set aside.
Fry capsicum and garlic in the pot, stir in the rice, crushed tomato, smoked paprika and 700 ml water.
Put the chicken back on top, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas for the last 4 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop garlic, green beans and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 37 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon and serve hot.

name: Lamb Orzo Style
steps: Fry lamb mince and onion in olive oil with cinnamon until browned.
Stir in crushed tomato and 500 ml water and bring to a simmer.
Add the pasta and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Top with feta and serve.

name: Chickpea Cauliflower Tagine
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas, cauliflower, carrot, cinnamon, cumin and honey and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the couscous.

name: Honey Beef Tagine
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, chickpeas, carrot, cinnamon, honey and cumin and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the couscous.

name: Chicken and Olive Tagine
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, olives, spinach and cumin and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the couscous, with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Fish Tagine
steps: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes.
Add white fish, capsicum and olives and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and crushed tomato and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the couscous.

name: Lamb and Sweet Potato Tagine
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, chickpeas, spinach, sweet potato, cinnamon, cumin and honey and stir well.
Add water to cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Meatball Sub Dinner
steps: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and garlic and shape into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs for 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Warm the tomato passata in the pan with the meatballs for 3 minutes.
Fill the bread rolls with meatballs and sauce.
Top with mozzarella and basil and grill or warm until melted.

name: Mexican Meatballs with Mash
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, corn and taco seasoning and shape into meatballs.
Put in an oven dish, pour salsa over and top with cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft and mash with butter and milk, and serve the meatballs on the mash.

name: Creamy Pork and Mushroom
steps: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, mushroom and spinach and cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the pasta.

name: Peanut Chicken Stir Fry
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add chicken breast, capsicum, carrot and cabbage and cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter, soy sauce and chilli flakes and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.

name: Beef Coconut Noodle Curry
steps: Fry beef strips, onion, capsicum, garlic and ginger in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, stir in curry paste and simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Cook the noodles as the pack says and drain.
Serve the beef curry over the noodles.

name: Green Curry Fish Pot
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, green beans, capsicum and curry paste and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Vegetable Massaman Style
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
