Add carrot, frozen peas, potato, curry paste and peanut butter and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

name: Penang Prawn Curry
steps: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Add prawns, capsicum, green beans, curry paste and peanut butter and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice, with a squeeze of lime.

name: Tomato and Egg Stir Fry
steps: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, tomato and spinach and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Glazed Salmon Tray
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop green beans and sweet potato into chunks.
Add salmon, honey and soy sauce to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.

name: Stuffed Mushrooms with Couscous
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees.
Take the stems out of the mushrooms and chop the stems with garlic, spinach and tomato.
Mix with breadcrumbs, cheese and parsley.
Fill the mushroom caps with the mix.
Bake for 18 minutes and serve over couscous, made as the pack says.

name: Cauliflower Steaks with Chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Cut the cauliflower into thick steaks and put on a tray with chickpeas, smoked paprika and cumin.
Roast for 25 minutes until golden at the edges.
Serve over couscous, made as the pack says, with spinach stirred through.
Top with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Big Roast Veg Tray with Halloumi
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop red onion, zucchini, capsicum and sweet potato into chunks.
Add chickpeas and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with halloumi and lemon and serve hot.

name: Mexican Banana Yogurt Oat Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Add the fruit and oats.
Scatter the topping over each bowl.
Serve fresh.

name: Mexican Banana Oat Bowl with Cinnamon
steps: Put the oats and milk in a pot on medium heat.
Stir for 8 minutes until thick.
Spoon into bowls and top with the fruit and the topping.
Serve warm.

name: Mexican Capsicum Egg Scramble
steps: Whisk the eggs in a bowl.
Cook the capsicum in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set.
Top with the cheese and serve with the bread.

name: Mexican Black Bean Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs in a warm pan.
Warm the black beans with the capsicum.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mix and the sauce.
Roll up and serve warm.

name: Mexican Berry Yogurt Smoothie
steps: Put the fruit, yogurt, milk and oats in a blender.
Add the spinach.
Blend for 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Mexican Chicken and Capsicum Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Cook the chicken until done.
Slice the capsicum and the corn.
Spoon everything into bowls, add the sauce and serve.

name: Mexican Tuna Garden Salad with Bread
steps: Chop the capsicum and the corn.
Cook the tuna and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Put the greens and vegetables in a big bowl.
Top with the protein and the cheese, then serve with the bread.

name: Mexican Black Bean and Capsicum Soup
steps: Put the stock, the black beans and the capsicum in a big pot.
Add the sweet potato and the seasoning and bring to a gentle boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes until everything is tender.
Serve hot with the bread.

name: Mexican Black Bean and Capsicum Wrap
steps: Cook the black beans until done.
Slice the capsicum and tear the greens.
Fill the tortillas with the protein, vegetables and sauce.
Roll up, cut in half and serve.

name: Mexican Black Bean Pasta Salad with Corn
steps: Cook the pasta, drain and rinse with cold water.
Cook the black beans and let it cool a little.
Chop the capsicum and the corn.
Toss everything with the cheese, lemon and olive oil and serve.

name: Mexican Beef and Capsicum Rice Bowl with Corn
steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Sear the beef strips in a hot pan for 5 minutes.
Add the capsicum and the corn and cook for 5 minutes.
Toss with the sauce and the base and serve hot.

name: Mexican Black Bean and Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Warm the black beans with the capsicum.
Slice the corn.
Spoon into bowls, add the sauce and serve.

name: Mexican Chicken Tray Bake with Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop the potato and the capsicum into chunks.
Put the chicken, vegetables and seasoning on a big tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 30 minutes until cooked through and golden at the edges.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Mexican Black Bean Tomato Skillet with Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Add the black beans and the seasoning and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the tomato passata and add the vegetables.
Simmer for 18 minutes until the sauce thickens a little.
Serve over the rice.

name: Mexican Black Bean Pasta with Capsicum
steps: Cook the pasta in a big pot of water.
Cook the black beans in a wide pan.
Add the capsicum, the corn and the tomato passata and simmer for 8 minutes.
Toss the pasta through the sauce.
Top with the cheese and serve.

name: Mexican Beef Rice Stir Fry with Capsicum
steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Sear the beef strips in a very hot pan for 5 minutes.
Add the capsicum and the corn and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sauce, toss for 1 minute and serve with the base.

name: Mexican Black Bean Stew with Sweet Potato
steps: Put the stock, the black beans and the sweet potato in a big pot.
Add the capsicum, the crushed tomato and the seasoning.
Simmer for 30 minutes until tender and thick.
Serve hot with the bread.

name: Mexican Stuffed Capsicum with Black Bean and Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Cook the rice and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Mix the rice with the black beans, the corn, the cheese, the seasoning and the tomato passata.
Fill the capsicum halves with the mix.
Bake for 25 minutes until soft and golden on top.

name: Mexican Chicken Plate with Rice and Greens
steps: Cook the rice and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Season the chicken and grill it until cooked through.
Steam the capsicum and the greens for 5 minutes.
Serve the protein with the grain, the vegetables and the sauce.

name: Mexican Chicken and Rice Dinner Salad
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool a little.
Cook the chicken and slice it.
Chop the capsicum and the corn.
Toss the grain and vegetables with the olive oil and lemon.
Top with the protein and the cheese and serve.

name: Greek Berry Yogurt Oat Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Add the fruit and oats.
Scatter the topping over each bowl.
Serve fresh.

name: Greek Berry Oat Bowl with Cinnamon
steps: Put the oats and milk in a pot on medium heat.
Stir for 8 minutes until thick.
Spoon into bowls and top with the fruit and the topping.
Serve warm.

name: Greek Spinach Egg Scramble
steps: Whisk the eggs in a bowl.
Cook the spinach in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set.
Top with the feta and serve with the bread.

name: Greek Chicken Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs in a warm pan.
Warm the chicken with the spinach.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mix and the sauce.
Roll up and serve warm.

name: Greek Banana Yogurt Smoothie
steps: Put the fruit, yogurt, milk and oats in a blender.
Add the spinach.
Blend for 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Greek Chickpeas and Cucumber Couscous Bowl
steps: Cook the couscous and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Cook the chickpeas until done.
Slice the cucumber and the tomato.
Spoon everything into bowls, add the sauce and serve.

name: Greek Chicken Garden Salad with Pita
steps: Chop the cucumber and the tomato.
Cook the chicken and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Put the greens and vegetables in a big bowl.
Top with the protein and the feta, then serve with the pita.

name: Greek Chickpeas and Cucumber Soup
steps: Put the stock, the chickpeas and the cucumber in a big pot.
Add the potato and the seasoning and bring to a gentle boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes until everything is tender.
Serve hot with the bread.

name: Greek Chicken and Cucumber Wrap
steps: Cook the chicken until done.
Slice the cucumber and tear the greens.
Fill the tortillas with the protein, vegetables and sauce.
Roll up, cut in half and serve.

name: Greek Chickpeas Pasta Salad with Tomato
steps: Cook the pasta, drain and rinse with cold water.
Cook the chickpeas and let it cool a little.
Chop the cucumber and the tomato.
Toss everything with the feta, lemon and olive oil and serve.

name: Greek Chicken and Cucumber Rice Bowl with Tomato
steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan for 5 minutes.
Add the cucumber and the tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Toss with the sauce and the base and serve hot.

name: Greek Chickpeas and Couscous Bowl
steps: Cook the couscous and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Warm the chickpeas with the cucumber.
Slice the tomato.
Spoon into bowls, add the sauce and serve.

name: Greek Chicken Tray Bake with Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200 degrees.
Chop the potato and the cucumber into chunks.
Put the chicken, vegetables and seasoning on a big tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 30 minutes until cooked through and golden at the edges.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Greek Chickpeas Tomato Skillet with Rice
steps: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Add the chickpeas and the seasoning and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the tomato passata and add the vegetables.
Simmer for 18 minutes until the sauce thickens a little.
Serve over the rice.

name: Greek Chickpeas Pasta with Cucumber
steps: Cook the pasta in a big pot of water.
Cook the chickpeas in a wide pan.
Add the cucumber, the tomato and the tomato passata and simmer for 8 minutes.
Toss the pasta through the sauce.
Top with the feta and serve.

name: Greek Chicken Rice Stir Fry with Cucumber
steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Sear the chicken in a very hot pan for 5 minutes.
Add the cucumber and the tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sauce, toss for 1 minute and serve with the base.

name: Greek Chickpeas Stew with Potato
steps: Put the stock, the chickpeas and the potato in a big pot.
Add the cucumber, the crushed tomato and the seasoning.
Simmer for 30 minutes until tender and thick.
Serve hot with the bread.

name: Greek Stuffed Capsicum with Chickpeas and Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 190 degrees.
Cook the rice and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Mix the rice with the chickpeas, the tomato, the feta, the seasoning and the tomato passata.
Fill the capsicum halves with the mix.
Bake for 25 minutes until soft and golden on top.

name: Greek Chicken Plate with Couscous and Greens
steps: Cook the couscous and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Season the chicken and grill it until cooked through.
Steam the cucumber and the greens for 5 minutes.
Serve the protein with the grain, the vegetables and the sauce.

name: Greek Chickpeas and Couscous Dinner Salad
steps: Cook the couscous and let it cool a little.
Cook the chickpeas and slice it.
Chop the cucumber and the tomato.
Toss the grain and vegetables with the olive oil and lemon.
Top with the protein and the feta and serve.

name: Mediterranean Orange Yogurt Oat Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Add the fruit and oats.
Scatter the topping over each bowl.
Serve fresh.

name: Mediterranean Orange Oat Bowl with Cinnamon
steps: Put the oats and milk in a pot on medium heat.
Stir for 8 minutes until thick.
Spoon into bowls and top with the fruit and the topping.
Serve warm.

name: Mediterranean Zucchini Egg Scramble
steps: Whisk the eggs in a bowl.
Cook the zucchini in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set.
Top with the feta and serve with the bread.

name: Mediterranean Chickpeas Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs in a warm pan.
Warm the chickpeas with the zucchini.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mix and the sauce.
Roll up and serve warm.

name: Mediterranean Banana Yogurt Smoothie
steps: Put the fruit, yogurt, milk and oats in a blender.
Add the spinach.
Blend for 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

name: Mediterranean Tofu and Zucchini Couscous Bowl
steps: Cook the couscous and let it rest for 5 minutes.
